c2233802.titulo: Cuts the workweek to 40 hours with 2 days off
c2233802.oQueMuda: The maximum workweek drops from 44 to 40 hours, up to 8 hours a day, with 2 paid days off (one preferably on Sunday), with no pay cut.
c2233802.quemAfeta: Workers with formal employment contracts and their employers.
c2233802.porQueImporta: It would end the 6-days-on, 1-day-off schedule (known as '6x1') and change the routine of millions of people.

c1228863.titulo: Lowers the age of criminal and civil adulthood to 16 and makes voting mandatory at 16
c1228863.oQueMuda: 16- and 17-year-olds would be tried as adults, gain full civil capacity, be required to vote and be able to run for office earlier.
c1228863.quemAfeta: 16- and 17-year-olds, the justice system and elections.
c1228863.porQueImporta: Today criminal adulthood starts at 18 and voting at 16 is optional; the change would alter the rights and duties of this age group.

c2140446.titulo: Ends special court privileges for ordinary crimes
c2140446.oQueMuda: Officials accused of ordinary crimes would no longer be tried by higher courts but by regular courts.
c2140446.quemAfeta: Politicians, judges and other officials who have special court privileges today.
c2140446.porQueImporta: It changes where and how officials are tried for crimes unrelated to their office.
c2140446.apelido: End of Special Court Privilege PEC

s8992908.titulo: Creates a national minimum salary for doctors and dentists
s8992908.oQueMuda: Doctors and dentists would be entitled to a national minimum salary, in public bodies and private companies.
s8992908.quemAfeta: Doctors, dentists and those who hire them, such as hospitals, clinics and city governments.
s8992908.porQueImporta: It would set a mandatory minimum pay for these professions nationwide.

c2388817.titulo: Lets former workers of Amapá, Roraima and Rondônia join the federal payroll
c2388817.oQueMuda: People who worked for the former territories or these states could be moved to a special federal staff.
c2388817.quemAfeta: Civil servants, police officers and workers who served in Amapá, Roraima and Rondônia.
c2388817.porQueImporta: The federal government would take over paying this group's salaries and pensions.

c347421.oQueMuda: It limits payments above the public salary cap to compensation allowances set by national law, creates limits on tax incentives and changes other spending rules. The original amendment dealt with the ICMS state tax, but its text was replaced.
c347421.porQueImporta: It is part of the spending-cut package approved at the end of 2024 (in the Senate, PEC 54/2024).

s9104654.titulo: Changes how Supreme Court justices are chosen
s9104654.oQueMuda: Creates new requirements for appointing Supreme Court justices and bars them from running for office for five years after leaving.
s9104654.quemAfeta: Current and future Supreme Court justices.
s9104654.porQueImporta: It changes how the country's highest court is formed.

c2551011.titulo: Requires full sentences in closed prison for heinous crimes
c2551011.oQueMuda: People convicted of torture, drug trafficking, terrorism and heinous crimes would serve their whole sentence in closed prison.
c2551011.quemAfeta: People convicted of these crimes and the prison system.
c2551011.porQueImporta: It would end moves to lighter prison regimes in these cases.

c621521.titulo: Allows a single unified police force in each state
c621521.oQueMuda: Federal and state governments could merge police forces into one that handles everything from patrols to investigation.
c621521.quemAfeta: Military police, civil police, firefighters and the people they serve.
c621521.porQueImporta: It would reorganize public safety, which today is split among police forces with different roles.

c2166443.titulo: Creates the National Public Safety Development Fund
c2166443.oQueMuda: Adds to the Constitution a fund with money set aside for public safety.
c2166443.quemAfeta: State governments, police forces and the public.
c2166443.porQueImporta: It would guarantee a steady source of funding for the area.

c2500080.titulo: Reorganizes public security and toughens penalties for gangs and militias
c2500080.oQueMuda: It defines the roles of the federal government, states and municipalities in public security, and requires the law to set harsher punishments for members of criminal factions, militias and perpetrators of violent crimes, such as maximum-security prisons and limits on sentence progression.
c2500080.quemAfeta: All levels of government, police forces, municipal guards, prisoners and crime victims.
c2500080.porQueImporta: It changes who is responsible for fighting crime and how the most serious crimes are punished.

c2644800.titulo: Confirms rural property titles in border areas
c2644800.oQueMuda: Validates rural land titles near the borders that states granted before 1988.
c2644800.porQueImporta: It would give legal certainty to these properties, which can be challenged today.

c354302.titulo: Grants autonomy to government attorney offices
c354302.oQueMuda: The Office of the Attorney General of the Union (AGU) and the attorney offices of states, the Federal District and municipalities would gain autonomy and their own prerogatives.
c354302.quemAfeta: Government attorneys and prosecutors who represent public bodies.
c354302.porQueImporta: It would change how independent these bodies are from the governments they serve.

c2432987.titulo: Gives budget autonomy to the AGU and state attorneys' offices
c2432987.oQueMuda: The Federal Attorney General's Office and state attorneys' offices would control their own budgets.
c2432987.quemAfeta: Government lawyers and the federal and state governments.
c2432987.porQueImporta: It would give more financial independence to the bodies that defend governments in court.

c2442880.titulo: Changes retirement rules for police and security officers
c2442880.oQueMuda: Changes special retirement criteria from the 2019 pension reform and creates specific rules for public safety.
c2442880.quemAfeta: Police officers and other public safety workers.
c2442880.porQueImporta: It would change when and with how much these workers can retire.

c483905.titulo: Allows judges and prosecutors to be dismissed as punishment
c483905.oQueMuda: Ends forced retirement as a penalty and allows loss of office in serious cases.
c483905.porQueImporta: Today the harshest penalty is usually retiring the judge with pay; this would change that.

c372537.titulo: Sets aside budget money for sports
c372537.oQueMuda: Creates a mandatory allocation of funds for sports in the Constitution.
c372537.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for the area.

c586407.titulo: Changes disciplinary rules for judges and prosecutors
c586407.oQueMuda: Regulates the disciplinary system for the judiciary and prosecutors.
c586407.porQueImporta: It defines how these professionals can be investigated and punished.

c520886.titulo: Bans retirement as a punishment for judges
c520886.oQueMuda: Judges punished for misconduct could no longer be forced into retirement with proportional pay.
c520886.porQueImporta: Today this retirement is the harshest administrative penalty for judges.

c2158594.titulo: Allows the National Council of Justice to dismiss judges
c2158594.oQueMuda: The National Council of Justice (CNJ) could order a judge's removal from office.
c2158594.porQueImporta: Today removal depends on a final court ruling.

c328385.titulo: Ends pension contributions from retired civil servants
c328385.oQueMuda: Retired civil servants and survivors would stop paying pension contributions.
c328385.quemAfeta: Retired civil servants, survivors and public finances.
c328385.porQueImporta: It would raise these retirees' income and reduce public pension revenue.

c2419252.titulo: Changes contribution and retirement rules for civil servants
c2419252.oQueMuda: Changes parts of the 2019 pension reform on extra contributions and rules for civil servants.
c2419252.porQueImporta: It affects how much civil servants pay into the pension system.

c2623400.titulo: Allows lowering the age of criminal responsibility for heinous crimes
c2623400.oQueMuda: In exceptional cases, such as heinous or extremely cruel crimes, teenagers could be tried as adults.
c2623400.porQueImporta: Today the age of criminal responsibility is 18 for all crimes.

c2623604.titulo: Lowers the minimum age of criminal responsibility
c2623604.oQueMuda: Lowers the age of criminal responsibility under the conditions in the proposal.
c2623604.porQueImporta: Today the age of criminal responsibility is 18.

s8325260.titulo: Allows municipal police and adds traffic agents to public security
s8325260.oQueMuda: Municipalities could have municipal guards or police doing visible local patrols, and traffic agents would become part of public security.
s8325260.quemAfeta: Municipal guards, traffic agents and city governments.
s8325260.porQueImporta: It expands the role of cities in public security.

s7753208.titulo: Creates forensic police forces in the states
s7753208.oQueMuda: Criminal forensics would become its own public safety body, reporting to the governor.
s7753208.quemAfeta: Forensic experts and state police forces.
s7753208.porQueImporta: It separates forensics from the Civil Police, to which it is usually attached today.

c2504516.titulo: Removes the time limit to prosecute sexual crimes against children
c2504516.oQueMuda: Sexual crimes against children under 12 could be punished at any time, with no statute of limitations.
c2504516.quemAfeta: Victims of child sexual abuse and those accused of these crimes.
c2504516.porQueImporta: Today these crimes can go unpunished after a certain time.

c2576168.oQueMuda: Changes civil service rules to improve management, digitize services, professionalize staff and cut privileges.
c2576168.quemAfeta: Civil servants and people who use public services.
c2576168.porQueImporta: It affects how the state hires, evaluates and pays its employees.

c2604173.titulo: Caps the vehicle tax (IPVA) and limits ad and legislative spending
c2604173.oQueMuda: Sets a ceiling for the IPVA rate and limits spending on government advertising and the legislature.
c2604173.porQueImporta: It could lower vehicle taxes and the money states collect.

c2631190.titulo: Allows culture and sports incentive programs under the new tax
c2631190.oQueMuda: The IBS Management Committee could authorize states and municipalities to create programs in which donations and sponsorships for cultural and sports projects generate tax credits.
c2631190.quemAfeta: Sponsoring companies, artists, sports organizations, states and municipalities.
c2631190.porQueImporta: It would keep tax incentives for culture and sports in the new tax system.

c2633488.titulo: Exempts nonprofit sports organizations from taxes
c2633488.oQueMuda: Nonprofit clubs and sports organizations would stop paying certain taxes.
c2633488.porQueImporta: It would reduce these organizations' costs.

c2136725.titulo: Makes rape a crime without bail or time limit
c2136725.oQueMuda: Rape would no longer allow bail and could be punished at any time.
c2136725.quemAfeta: Rape victims and those accused of the crime.
c2136725.porQueImporta: Today the crime expires after a certain period.

c2234666.titulo: Changes how the Municipal Participation Fund is shared
c2234666.oQueMuda: Changes the rules for federal transfers to cities through the FPM.
c2234666.quemAfeta: City governments, especially those that depend on these transfers.
c2234666.porQueImporta: The FPM is one of the main sources of money for many cities.

c2091473.titulo: Lets associations of municipalities challenge laws at the Supreme Court
c2091473.oQueMuda: National associations of cities could file Supreme Court cases to challenge or defend laws.
c2091473.quemAfeta: City governments and their national associations.
c2091473.porQueImporta: It gives cities a direct path to the Supreme Court.

c2284555.titulo: Guarantees special retirement for community health workers
c2284555.oQueMuda: Creates protections and special retirement for community health and disease-control workers.
c2284555.quemAfeta: Community health and disease-control workers, and city governments.
c2284555.porQueImporta: It defines rights for workers at the front line of the public health system (SUS).

c412505.titulo: Creates the National Technical Education Fund
c412505.oQueMuda: Sets aside tax money to fund technical education.
c412505.porQueImporta: It would guarantee dedicated funding for this type of education.

c527081.titulo: Directs tax money to the Uruguay River region
c527081.oQueMuda: Sets aside part of income tax and IPI for a development fund for the Uruguay River basin.
c527081.quemAfeta: Cities and residents of the Uruguay River basin, in the South.
c527081.porQueImporta: It would create a permanent regional funding source.

c1701023.titulo: Creates a fund for the Uruguay River region
c1701023.oQueMuda: Creates the Uruguay River Basin Development Fund with federal money.
c1701023.quemAfeta: Cities and residents of the Uruguay River basin.
c1701023.porQueImporta: It would create a permanent regional funding source.

s7864739.oQueMuda: The federal government would legislate on cyber defense, and all governments would protect the digital security of public services.
s7864739.quemAfeta: Governments and users of digital public services.
s7864739.porQueImporta: It organizes protection against cyberattacks on public bodies.

c796797.titulo: Creates a fund for technical high school education
c796797.oQueMuda: Creates Fundetec, a fund to finance technical education at the high school level.
c796797.porQueImporta: It would guarantee dedicated funding for this type of education.

c1672354.titulo: Creates the Racial Equality Promotion Fund
c1672354.oQueMuda: Creates a federally funded fund for racial equality policies.
c1672354.quemAfeta: Black Brazilians and public anti-racism policies.
c1672354.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for these policies.

c1713489.titulo: Creates a national fund for racial equality and reparations
c1713489.oQueMuda: Creates a fund to promote racial equality, fight racism and repair harm.
c1713489.quemAfeta: Black Brazilians and public anti-racism policies.
c1713489.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for these policies.

c2557024.titulo: Changes how recycling is taxed under the tax reform
c2557024.oQueMuda: Creates specific tax treatment for the recycling sector in the new tax system.
c2557024.quemAfeta: Waste pickers, cooperatives and recycling companies.
c2557024.porQueImporta: It could lower taxes on recycled materials.

c2458742.titulo: Makes early childhood a priority in the Constitution
c2458742.oQueMuda: Young children would have rights and guarantees explicitly named in the Constitution.
c2458742.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty toward this age group.

s8986903.titulo: Changes employers' social security contributions from 2027
s8986903.oQueMuda: Changes how employers' social security contributions apply to payroll and revenue, with a maximum rate.
s8986903.quemAfeta: Companies, workers and the social security system.
s8986903.porQueImporta: It affects the cost of hiring and the money that funds social security.

s8828166.titulo: Creates a national policy to support truck drivers
s8828166.oQueMuda: It sets up a national policy for professional drivers, including rest stops at regular intervals along highways.
s8828166.porQueImporta: It puts support for a key profession for freight and passenger transport into the Constitution.

s9065675.titulo: Keeps local culture and sports incentives under the new tax
s9065675.oQueMuda: Preserves, under the IBS, state and city programs that give tax breaks to supporters of culture and sports.
s9065675.quemAfeta: Artists, sports organizations, sponsors and local governments.
s9065675.porQueImporta: It prevents these incentives from ending with the tax reform.

c2341717.titulo: Makes Audit Courts permanent and bans creating or abolishing them
c2341717.oQueMuda: Audit Courts would become permanent bodies essential to overseeing public spending, and abolishing, creating or setting up new ones would be prohibited.
c2341717.quemAfeta: Audit Courts and the governments they oversee.
c2341717.porQueImporta: It strengthens the bodies that oversee how public money is used.

c2436224.titulo: Promotes federal nursing assistants to nursing technicians
c2436224.oQueMuda: Federal employees working as nursing assistants would move to the nursing technician career.
c2436224.quemAfeta: Nursing assistants in the federal civil service.
c2436224.porQueImporta: It would change this group's position and pay.

c2485767.titulo: Sets guidelines for careers and minimum pay of public health workers
c2485767.oQueMuda: Defines general rules for career plans and national minimum salaries for health workers in the public system (SUS).
c2485767.quemAfeta: Public health workers and the governments that hire them.
c2485767.porQueImporta: It affects the pay of people who work in the public health system.

s8593552.titulo: Gives the Central Bank financial autonomy and changes its legal status
s8593552.oQueMuda: The Central Bank would have technical, administrative, budgetary and financial autonomy. The original text made it a state-owned company; the latest Senate report defines it as a special public entity.
s8593552.quemAfeta: The Central Bank, its staff and the financial system.
s8593552.porQueImporta: It changes how the body that controls the currency and interest rates is organized and funded.

c2351506.titulo: Expands tax immunity for churches and non-profit organizations
c2351506.oQueMuda: Churches and religious bodies, as well as daycare centers, therapeutic communities, monasteries, seminaries, convents and other non-profits, would no longer pay taxes built into their purchases of goods and services, under rules set by a complementary law.
c2351506.quemAfeta: Churches, religious organizations and non-profit social assistance entities.
c2351506.porQueImporta: It would reduce taxes paid by these entities and government revenue.

s9038492.titulo: Creates a special tax regime for soccer clubs and sports
s9038492.oQueMuda: Clubs, soccer associations and nonprofit sports organizations could have specific taxation under the IBS.
s9038492.porQueImporta: It could lower the taxes paid by the sports sector.

s9055580.titulo: Lets workers choose a flexible hourly schedule
s9055580.oQueMuda: Employees could choose between the standard CLT work schedule and a flexible arrangement paid by the hour.
s9055580.porQueImporta: It changes the employment contract options in the country.

c2485341.titulo: Cuts the workweek to 36 hours over 4 days
c2485341.oQueMuda: The maximum workweek would be 36 hours, up to 8 hours a day, over 4 days a week; the rule would take effect 360 days after approval.
c2485341.quemAfeta: Workers with formal employment contracts and employers.
c2485341.porQueImporta: It would end the 6-days-on, 1-day-off schedule ('6x1') and change how companies organize work.
c2485341.apelido: End of the 6x1 schedule amendment (4-day week)

s8548483.titulo: Sets a time limit ('marco temporal') for recognizing Indigenous lands
s8548483.oQueMuda: Only lands occupied by Indigenous peoples on October 5, 1988 could be recognized as Indigenous; it also bans expanding lands already demarcated.
s8548483.quemAfeta: Indigenous peoples, farmers and residents of disputed areas.
s8548483.porQueImporta: It changes which lands can be recognized as Indigenous, an issue the Supreme Court decided differently.

s8938455.titulo: Adds productive efficiency to the principles of the economy
s8938455.oQueMuda: The Constitution would list productive efficiency and efficient use of resources as principles of the economic order.
s8938455.quemAfeta: Governments, companies and lawmakers who write economic laws.
s8938455.porQueImporta: It would guide laws and decisions about the economy.

s9050555.titulo: Creates a code of conduct for public officials
s9050555.oQueMuda: Adds to the Constitution rules of conduct, duties and prohibitions for public officials, focused on avoiding conflicts of interest.
s9050555.quemAfeta: Civil servants, politicians and other public officials.
s9050555.porQueImporta: It sets behavior limits for people who work for the state.

c2361500.titulo: Recognizes court bailiffs as a state career
c2361500.oQueMuda: Court bailiffs would get their own section in the Constitution and different retirement rules.
c2361500.porQueImporta: It would change this group's status and retirement.

c2340881.titulo: Adds notary representatives to the National Council of Justice (CNJ)
c2340881.oQueMuda: The National Council of Justice would gain two members: a notary and a registrar.
c2340881.quemAfeta: Notary offices and the National Council of Justice.
c2340881.porQueImporta: It would give notary offices a voice in the body that oversees them.

c257418.titulo: Allows Congress to summon heads of state-owned companies
c257418.oQueMuda: The Chamber, the Senate and committees could require heads of companies with federal stakes to give information in person.
c257418.quemAfeta: Presidents and directors of state-owned companies, such as Petrobras and public banks.
c257418.porQueImporta: It expands Congress's oversight of state-owned companies.

s9047816.titulo: Creates a national minimum salary for military police and firefighters
s9047816.oQueMuda: Military police officers and military firefighters would have a national minimum salary set by federal law.
s9047816.quemAfeta: Military police, firefighters and the state governments that pay them.
s9047816.porQueImporta: It affects state spending and these workers' pay.

s7733780.titulo: Lowers the age of criminal responsibility to 16, and 14 for serious crimes
s7733780.oQueMuda: Young people from 16 would be tried as adults; for heinous crimes, drug trafficking and terrorism, from 14.
s7733780.quemAfeta: Teenagers and the justice and prison systems.
s7733780.porQueImporta: Today the age of criminal responsibility is 18.

s8318028.titulo: Adds municipal guards to public safety
s8318028.oQueMuda: Municipal guards would officially become part of the public safety bodies.
s8318028.porQueImporta: It expands cities' role in public safety.

c2362526.titulo: Creates a Unified Mobility System and a fee for road use
c2362526.oQueMuda: Sets guidelines for the right to transportation and allows a fee for road use to fund public transit.
c2362526.quemAfeta: Bus and subway riders, drivers and city governments.
c2362526.porQueImporta: It could lower public transit fares through a new charge.

c14666.titulo: Expands who Congress can summon to testify
c14666.oQueMuda: Ministers, heads of agencies, regulators and state-owned companies could be summoned by Congress.

c2162116.titulo: Guarantees minimum funding for social assistance (SUAS)
c2162116.oQueMuda: The federal government would have to spend a minimum share of its revenue on the Unified Social Assistance System.
c2162116.quemAfeta: People served by social assistance and governments.
c2162116.porQueImporta: It would guarantee funding for services for vulnerable people.

s9017996.titulo: Requires suspects and witnesses to appear before inquiry committees
s9017996.oQueMuda: Suspects and witnesses would have to appear before parliamentary inquiry committees (CPIs), with possible forced appearance and fines.
s9017996.quemAfeta: People summoned by parliamentary inquiry committees.
s9017996.porQueImporta: It increases CPIs' power to hear those they call.

c2121543.oQueMuda: Rights such as health, education and work could no longer be abolished by constitutional amendments.
c2121543.porQueImporta: It would stop future amendments from removing these rights.

c546158.titulo: Lets police officers also work as teachers or health workers
c546158.oQueMuda: Police officers could hold a second public job as a teacher or health worker; police and guard posts would count as technical jobs.
c546158.porQueImporta: Today holding these two public jobs at once is not allowed.

c463451.titulo: Ties military police and firefighter pay to Federal District levels
c463451.oQueMuda: Military police officers and firefighters in every state could not earn less than those in the Federal District, including retirees, with help from a federal fund.
c463451.quemAfeta: Military police officers, firefighters (active and retired) and the governments that pay them.
c463451.porQueImporta: It affects the pay of these workers and state and federal spending.

c414367.titulo: Matches state military police pay to the Federal District's
c414367.oQueMuda: State military police and firefighters, including retirees, could not earn less than those in the Federal District.
c414367.quemAfeta: Military police, firefighters and state governments.
c414367.porQueImporta: It would raise salaries and spending in most states.

c2323056.titulo: Adds the solidarity economy to the principles of the economy
c2323056.oQueMuda: Cooperatives and solidarity economy initiatives would be named as a principle of the economic order.
c2323056.porQueImporta: It would support policies backing the sector.

s8082738.titulo: Makes Brazilian Sign Language (Libras) an official language
s8082738.oQueMuda: Brazilian Sign Language would become an official language alongside Portuguese.
s8082738.porQueImporta: It strengthens the right to be served in Libras.

s8440723.titulo: Sets minimum values for the nursing minimum wage
s8440723.oQueMuda: Sets minimum amounts for the national minimum salaries of nurses, technicians, nursing assistants and midwives.
s8440723.quemAfeta: Nursing professionals and those who hire them.
s8440723.porQueImporta: It affects the pay of one of the largest groups of health workers.

s8600341.titulo: Shields media outlets from liability for what interviewees say
s8600341.oQueMuda: Media outlets would not be civilly liable for false accusations or insults made by interviewees.
s8600341.quemAfeta: Newspapers, broadcasters, journalists and people mentioned in reports.
s8600341.porQueImporta: It changes who pays damages when an interview offends someone.

s8622662.titulo: Bans retirement as a punishment for public officials
s8622662.oQueMuda: Judges, prosecutors and military personnel punished for misconduct could no longer be retired as a sanction.
s8622662.porQueImporta: Today this retirement is the harshest administrative penalty in these careers.

s8640436.titulo: Requires 24-hour Public Defender service for health and domestic violence
s8640436.oQueMuda: Public Defender's Offices would offer uninterrupted service, prioritizing health matters and domestic violence.
s8640436.quemAfeta: People who need the courts to obtain treatment and domestic violence victims.
s8640436.porQueImporta: It makes urgent requests for medicines, hospital beds, surgeries and protective measures easier.

s8664568.titulo: Ties the nursing minimum wage to a 30-hour week
s8664568.oQueMuda: The nursing minimum salary would apply to a maximum 30-hour workweek.
s8664568.porQueImporta: In practice it would raise the hourly pay for these workers.

c2231327.titulo: Extends the pension reform to states and cities
c2231327.oQueMuda: States and cities could adopt federal pension rules; it also creates a benefit for children in poverty.
c2231327.quemAfeta: State and city civil servants, and poor children.
c2231327.porQueImporta: It would change retirement rules for millions of civil servants.

c439075.titulo: Unifies elections, ends reelection and changes term lengths
c439075.oQueMuda: All elections would happen together, terms would be 5 years (10 for senators) and executives could not be reelected.
c439075.porQueImporta: It would change the country's whole election calendar.

c608998.titulo: Adds lawyers to small claims courts
c608998.oQueMuda: Lawyers would sit on small claims courts and their appeal panels.
c608998.quemAfeta: Lawyers and people who use small claims courts.
c608998.porQueImporta: It changes who judges smaller cases.

c2214856.titulo: Expands who can move human rights cases to federal courts
c2214856.oQueMuda: More authorities could ask the Superior Court of Justice to send serious human rights violations to federal courts.
c2214856.quemAfeta: Victims of serious human rights violations.
c2214856.porQueImporta: It makes it easier to take cases out of state courts.

c2229382.titulo: Lets temporary acting executives run for office
c2229382.oQueMuda: Speakers of city councils and state assemblies who briefly replace a mayor or governor would not become ineligible.

c590035.oQueMuda: Removes from the Constitution the mandatory collection of union dues.
c590035.porQueImporta: It affects unions' main source of funding.

c2126901.titulo: Requires the income tax table to be updated
c2126901.oQueMuda: The personal income tax brackets and deductions would have mandatory periodic adjustments.
c2126901.porQueImporta: Without adjustment, inflation pushes more people into paying tax.

c2402861.titulo: Turns municipal guards into municipal police
c2402861.oQueMuda: Creates municipal police forces and changes retirement rules for guards and prison police.
c2402861.quemAfeta: Municipal guards, prison police and city governments.
c2402861.porQueImporta: It expands cities' role in policing.

s8937612.oQueMuda: Creates rules and funding to expand full-day public education.
s8937612.quemAfeta: Students, families and public school systems.
s8937612.porQueImporta: It affects how many hours children spend at school.

s8950015.titulo: Guarantees women the right to a life free of violence
s8950015.oQueMuda: Adds women's right to live without violence, at home and in public, to fundamental rights.
s8950015.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to prevent violence against women.

s8951742.titulo: Protects people close to retirement from sudden rule changes
s8951742.oQueMuda: Adds the principle of legitimate expectations on pension rules to the Constitution.
s8951742.quemAfeta: People insured by the pension system.
s8951742.porQueImporta: It would make abrupt rule changes harder for those already contributing.

c2332037.titulo: Creates higher minimum pay for health agents with technical training
c2332037.oQueMuda: Community health and disease-control agents with technical training would have a separate minimum salary.
c2332037.quemAfeta: Community health agents and city governments.
c2332037.porQueImporta: It affects the pay of primary care workers.

c2447265.titulo: Creates an economic reparations fund for Black Brazilians
c2447265.oQueMuda: Adds a racial equality chapter to the Constitution and a fund to create opportunities for Black and brown Brazilians.
c2447265.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for reparation policies.

s7732421.titulo: Allows public university students to give something back
s7732421.oQueMuda: Public education stays free, but university students could provide community services in return.
s7732421.porQueImporta: It changes the rule of completely free public higher education.

s7825125.titulo: Takes the education payroll contribution out of the spending cap
s7825125.oQueMuda: Spending paid with the education payroll contribution (salário-educação) would no longer count toward the federal spending limit.
s7825125.porQueImporta: It would allow more education spending without breaking the fiscal limit.

s8639162.titulo: Gives states the power to make prison laws
s8639162.oQueMuda: States alone would set the rules for serving sentences and running prisons.
s8639162.quemAfeta: Prisoners, prison staff and state governments.
s8639162.porQueImporta: Prison rules could vary from state to state.

c560156.titulo: Lets administrative civil servants also work as teachers
c560156.oQueMuda: Civil servants in administrative careers could hold a second job as a teacher.
c560156.porQueImporta: Today only technical jobs can be combined with teaching.

c1504922.titulo: Allows combining a teaching-support job with teaching
c1504922.oQueMuda: Professionals in teaching-support posts could hold another teaching job.
c1504922.porQueImporta: It expands the options for holding two public jobs.

c276180.titulo: Requires a public exam to hire justices of the peace
c276180.oQueMuda: Justices of the peace would be chosen through a public exam; current ones stay until their seat opens.
c276180.quemAfeta: Justices of the peace and people getting married in civil ceremonies.
c276180.porQueImporta: Today the rule calls for an election to the post.

s8999790.oQueMuda: The President could not run for the next term.
s8999790.porQueImporta: Presidential reelection has been allowed since 1997.

c2578996.titulo: Lets workers choose a flexible hourly schedule
c2578996.oQueMuda: Employees could choose between the standard CLT work schedule and a flexible arrangement paid by the hour.
c2578996.porQueImporta: It changes the employment contract options in the country.

c542454.titulo: Allows judges to be removed for misconduct
c542454.oQueMuda: Bans retirement as a punishment and provides for judges to lose office for breach of decorum.
c542454.porQueImporta: Today the harshest penalty is usually retiring the judge with pay.

s8831744.oQueMuda: Changes articles on the use of education funds, such as the education payroll contribution and transfers to non-state schools.
s8831744.porQueImporta: It affects how education money is distributed.

s8900982.titulo: Has city council members tried by state courts
s8900982.oQueMuda: Municipal charters could provide that city council members be tried by the state courts of justice.
s8900982.porQueImporta: It would create a kind of special court privilege for council members.

c500183.oQueMuda: Teenagers from age 14 could work part-time.
c500183.porQueImporta: Today, before 16, only apprenticeships are allowed.

c2118618.titulo: Splits legislative seats equally between men and women
c2118618.oQueMuda: Seats in the Chamber, the Senate, state assemblies and city councils would be divided half and half.
c2118618.porQueImporta: Today women hold a small share of seats.

c2224818.titulo: Gives the Federal Police investigative autonomy
c2224818.oQueMuda: Guarantees the Federal Police investigative and technical-scientific autonomy.
c2224818.quemAfeta: The Federal Police and the federal government.
c2224818.porQueImporta: It would change how independent the Federal Police is.

c1299731.titulo: Sets pay rules for the Federal Highway Police
c1299731.oQueMuda: Sets constitutional parameters for the pay of federal highway police officers.

c2188961.titulo: Changes how FPM transfers to cities are calculated
c2188961.oQueMuda: The Municipal Participation Fund amount would be based on the average of the previous 48 months.
c2188961.porQueImporta: It would make transfers more stable, with fewer ups and downs.

c2377463.titulo: Bans decriminalizing drugs, including possession for personal use
c2377463.oQueMuda: It makes fighting drug trafficking, production, possession and use a national goal and bans decriminalizing these acts, even possession for personal use.
c2377463.quemAfeta: The whole population, drug users and the justice system.
c2377463.porQueImporta: It would block changes to drug policy through ordinary laws or court rulings.

c2380340.titulo: Changes pensions for city civil servants
c2380340.oQueMuda: Changes the rules of city pension systems to balance their accounts.
c2380340.quemAfeta: City civil servants and city governments.
c2380340.porQueImporta: It affects retirement rules and city finances.

c579931.titulo: Creates a Constitutional Court and changes the STJ and CNJ
c579931.oQueMuda: Creates a court only for constitutional matters and changes the makeup and appointments of the Superior Court of Justice and the National Council of Justice.
c579931.quemAfeta: Higher courts and people who appeal to them.
c579931.porQueImporta: It would reorganize the top of the judiciary.

c514540.titulo: Allows seizing land where illegal hunting occurs
c514540.oQueMuda: Rural properties with illegal hunting could be expropriated and used for land reform.
c514540.porQueImporta: It creates a severe penalty for an environmental crime.

c384232.oQueMuda: People not affiliated with a party could run, as long as they have support from a minimum number of voters.
c384232.quemAfeta: Voters, parties and possible independent candidates.
c384232.porQueImporta: Today you can only run through a party.

c2086220.titulo: Creates recall: voters could remove officials
c2086220.oQueMuda: Citizens could vote to remove a president, governor or mayor, with prior approval from the legislature.
c2086220.quemAfeta: Voters and heads of the executive branch.
c2086220.porQueImporta: It would give voters a way to end a term early.

c2088445.titulo: Adopts a parliamentary system in Brazil
c2088445.oQueMuda: The government would be led by a prime minister chosen with the support of Congress, who could be removed by a vote of no confidence.
c2088445.porQueImporta: It would change the system of government; in 1993 Brazilians chose presidentialism in a referendum.

c113412.titulo: Limits spending on ads for government projects
c113412.oQueMuda: Sets limits on what governments and state-owned companies can spend advertising public works and campaigns.
c113412.porQueImporta: It would cut public spending on advertising.

c145695.titulo: Sets rules for raising politicians' and officials' salaries
c145695.oQueMuda: Defines criteria for reviewing the salaries of top officials, legislators, ministers and secretaries.
c145695.porQueImporta: It limits how these salaries can be raised.

c320708.titulo: Lets municipal guards patrol the streets
c320708.oQueMuda: Municipal guards could do street patrols through an agreement with the state.
c320708.quemAfeta: Municipal guards, military police and city governments.
c320708.porQueImporta: It expands the guards' role in public safety.

c453251.titulo: Gives autonomy to the Federal Police
c453251.oQueMuda: A complementary law would give the Federal Police operational and administrative autonomy and the power to propose its own budget.
c453251.quemAfeta: The Federal Police and the federal government.
c453251.porQueImporta: It would change how independent the Federal Police is from the government.

c589892.titulo: Ends the benefit for prisoners' families and creates one for crime victims
c589892.oQueMuda: The benefit paid to prisoners' dependents would end and a new benefit would be created for victims and their dependents.
c589892.porQueImporta: It changes who receives support from social security and assistance.

c2081963.titulo: Extends a benefit to orphans who grew up in shelters until age 21
c2081963.oQueMuda: Young orphans who lived in institutional care would receive one minimum wage a month from 18 to 21.
c2081963.quemAfeta: Young people who grew up in shelters.
c2081963.porQueImporta: It would provide income during the transition to adulthood.

c2174497.titulo: Lets cities charge a fee to revitalize urban areas
c2174497.oQueMuda: Cities and the Federal District could create a contribution to pay for revitalization works in specific areas.
c2174497.quemAfeta: Residents and businesses in those areas, and city governments.
c2174497.porQueImporta: It would create a new local charge.

c2225224.titulo: Lets teachers hold another public job
c2225224.oQueMuda: A teacher could hold a second paid public job in any field.
c2225224.porQueImporta: Today teachers can only combine with another teaching or technical job.

c2598301.titulo: Adds civil servants to the CNJ and CNMP
c2598301.oQueMuda: Changes the councils that oversee the judiciary and prosecutors to include civil servants.
c2598301.quemAfeta: Staff of the judiciary and prosecutors' offices.
c2598301.porQueImporta: It gives staff a voice in oversight bodies.

c1307014.titulo: Creates the Rio Branco Free Trade Zone, in Acre
c1307014.oQueMuda: Creates an area with tax benefits for companies in Rio Branco.
c1307014.porQueImporta: It aims to attract industry with tax cuts.

c434376.titulo: Requires full sentences in closed prison for heinous crimes
c434376.oQueMuda: People who commit heinous crimes would serve the entire sentence in closed prison.
c434376.quemAfeta: People convicted of heinous crimes and the prison system.
c434376.porQueImporta: It would end moves to lighter regimes in these cases.

c2596372.titulo: Allows restrictions on lottery and betting ads
c2596372.oQueMuda: The law could limit or ban advertising for lotteries and sports betting.
c2596372.quemAfeta: Betting companies, media outlets and bettors.
c2596372.porQueImporta: It would affect advertising in a sector that has grown a lot.

c2595818.titulo: Lets education professionals hold two public jobs
c2595818.oQueMuda: Other education professionals, besides teachers, could hold two public jobs.
c2595818.porQueImporta: It expands the rules on holding multiple jobs.

s8611954.titulo: Exempts cars 20 years or older from vehicle tax (IPVA)
s8611954.oQueMuda: Passenger vehicles 20 or more years old would stop paying IPVA nationwide.
s8611954.quemAfeta: Owners of older cars and the states.
s8611954.porQueImporta: Today each state sets this exemption, with different ages.

c2140426.titulo: Creates a popular veto on laws
c2140426.oQueMuda: Voters could strike down approved laws, following set criteria.
c2140426.porQueImporta: It would be a new form of direct public participation.

s1396298.titulo: Cuts the workweek to 36 hours over up to 5 days
s1396298.oQueMuda: Under the version approved by the Senate committee, the maximum workweek would be 36 hours over up to 5 days, with 2 days off (preferably Saturday and Sunday).
s1396298.quemAfeta: Workers with formal employment contracts and employers.
s1396298.porQueImporta: It would end the 6-days-on, 1-day-off schedule ('6x1') and change the routine of millions of people.

s8815148.titulo: Adds the juvenile detention system to public safety
s8815148.oQueMuda: Bodies that apply measures to juvenile offenders would become part of public safety, with jobs filled by public exam.
s8815148.quemAfeta: Juvenile detention staff and detained teenagers.

s8060173.titulo: Limits individual decisions by Supreme Court justices
s8060173.oQueMuda: Sets deadlines for requests for review and requires a majority of the court to suspend laws or acts of other branches.
s8060173.porQueImporta: It reduces a single justice's power to suspend laws.

s8639911.titulo: Lets Indigenous peoples freely sell what they produce
s8639911.oQueMuda: Indigenous peoples could produce and sell freely, and the federal government would have to give technical support.
s8639911.porQueImporta: It changes rules on economic activity on Indigenous lands.

c2391567.titulo: Lets Congress overturn Supreme Court rulings
c2391567.oQueMuda: Congress could suspend, by a qualified majority, final Supreme Court rulings it considers beyond the Court's limits.
c2391567.porQueImporta: It would shift the balance between the legislative and judicial branches.
c2391567.apelido: PEC letting Congress overturn Supreme Court rulings

s8968311.titulo: Lets any citizen file charges against Supreme Court justices
s8968311.oQueMuda: Restores citizens' right to file impeachable-offense charges against Supreme Court justices.
s8968311.quemAfeta: Citizens, the Senate and Supreme Court justices.
s8968311.porQueImporta: It affects the path to impeachment requests against justices.

c2591196.titulo: Counts school meals as education spending
c2591196.oQueMuda: Spending on school meals would count toward the minimum governments must invest in education.
c2591196.porQueImporta: It could reduce money for other education expenses.

s8966726.titulo: Changes how Supreme Court justices are chosen
s8966726.oQueMuda: Changes the appointment process, with participation of the National Council of Justice and a list of candidates.
s8966726.quemAfeta: The President, the Senate and the Supreme Court.
s8966726.porQueImporta: It changes how the country's highest court is formed.

s8789546.titulo: Gives Congress power over public safety rules
s8789546.oQueMuda: Congress alone would set general rules on public safety, social defense and prisons.
s8789546.quemAfeta: Federal and state governments and the police.
s8789546.porQueImporta: It changes who decides public safety rules.

s8961392.titulo: Protects people's honor and image even after death
s8961392.oQueMuda: Privacy, honor and image would remain protected after death, with the right to compensation.
s8961392.quemAfeta: Families of deceased people and media outlets.
s8961392.porQueImporta: It extends protections already given to the living.

c2543145.titulo: Creates anti-privilege rules for public officials
c2543145.oQueMuda: Bans certain perks and salary equivalences between politicians and civil servants.
c2543145.porQueImporta: It aims to cut benefits seen as excessive.

s7757038.titulo: Lets the federal government hand ports, railways and energy to states
s7757038.oQueMuda: States could run ports, railways and energy, and keep increases in federal revenue collected in their territory.
s7757038.quemAfeta: State governments and the federal government.
s7757038.porQueImporta: It would give states more power and money.

s7737114.titulo: Sends oil royalties to education and health
s7737114.oQueMuda: Oil money from new fields would go 75% to education and 25% to health, outside the spending cap.
s7737114.porQueImporta: It would create a steady funding source for these areas.

c2479738.titulo: Creates special working conditions for professional drivers
c2479738.oQueMuda: Sets specific rules for drivers employed in freight and passenger transport.
c2479738.quemAfeta: Truck and bus drivers and companies.
c2479738.porQueImporta: It affects working hours and rights of an essential category.

c2225743.titulo: Creates the Teresina Free Trade Zone, in Piauí
c2225743.oQueMuda: Creates an area with tax benefits for companies in Teresina.
c2225743.porQueImporta: It aims to attract industry with tax cuts.

c334449.titulo: Extends special retirement to other education professionals
c334449.oQueMuda: Principals, coordinators and counselors would have the same special retirement as teachers.
c334449.porQueImporta: It would let them retire earlier.

s8951883.titulo: Requires Congress to vote on citizen-initiated bills
s8951883.oQueMuda: Citizen-initiated bills or requests from a majority of legislators would have to be considered.
s8951883.porQueImporta: It would keep these proposals from stalling.

c2471383.titulo: Sets aside part of legislators' budget amendments for sports
c2471383.oQueMuda: Part of deputies' and senators' individual budget amendments would have to go to sports programs.
c2471383.porQueImporta: It would guarantee sports funding in the budget.

c2336011.titulo: Raises the March FPM transfer by 1.5%
c2336011.oQueMuda: The federal government would hand an extra 1.5% of its revenue to the Municipal Participation Fund every March.

c2363434.titulo: Changes the FPM and creates funds for the South and Southeast
c2363434.oQueMuda: Changes how the FPM is shared and creates constitutional financing funds for the South and Southeast regions.
c2363434.quemAfeta: City governments and companies in these regions.
c2363434.porQueImporta: It affects how federal money is split among regions.

c2122682.titulo: Makes Audit Courts permanent and bans creating or abolishing them
c2122682.oQueMuda: Audit Courts would become permanent bodies essential to overseeing public spending, and abolishing, creating or setting up new ones would be prohibited.
c2122682.quemAfeta: Audit Courts and the governments they oversee.
c2122682.porQueImporta: It strengthens the bodies that oversee how public money is used.

s8941223.titulo: Creates fixed terms and new requirements for Supreme Court justices
s8941223.oQueMuda: Changes age and requirements and creates fixed terms for Supreme Court justices.
s8941223.quemAfeta: Current and future Supreme Court justices.
s8941223.porQueImporta: Today the post is held for life until age 75.

c2467670.titulo: Gives the Chamber power to oversee regulatory agencies
c2467670.oQueMuda: The Chamber of Deputies would have its own power to oversee regulatory agencies.
c2467670.quemAfeta: Agencies such as Anatel, Aneel and ANS.
c2467670.porQueImporta: It increases political control over these agencies.

c555267.titulo: Bans government advertising except for public service messages
c555267.oQueMuda: Public bodies could only run public service advertising.
c555267.porQueImporta: It would cut spending on official advertising.

c1212600.titulo: Bans government slogans and branding in official ads
c1212600.oQueMuda: Official advertising could not use slogans, logos or colors that identify those in power.
c1212600.porQueImporta: It aims to prevent self-promotion with public money.

c1584971.titulo: Bans identifying officeholders in official ads
c1584971.oQueMuda: Official advertising could not include anything that identifies the officeholder.
c1584971.porQueImporta: It aims to prevent self-promotion with public money.

s8810165.titulo: Allows bonus points for local applicants to federal universities
s8810165.oQueMuda: Federal universities could give extra points to applicants born or living in the region.
s8810165.porQueImporta: It would change the competition for places through the national exam (Enem).

c2293703.titulo: Reserves 30% of campaign funds for women candidates
c2293703.oQueMuda: Parties would have to give at least 30% of their funds and TV and radio time to women candidates.
c2293703.porQueImporta: It aims to increase women's presence in politics.

c355205.titulo: Creates a single salary cap for the whole public sector
c355205.oQueMuda: The maximum salary would be the same in federal, state and city governments.
c355205.porQueImporta: Today there are different caps depending on the level of government.

c2270800.titulo: Requires Congress's permission to prosecute members of Congress
c2270800.oQueMuda: The Supreme Court could only open a criminal case against a lawmaker with prior permission from the Chamber or the Senate, in a secret vote by an absolute majority.
c2270800.quemAfeta: Federal deputies, senators and the Supreme Federal Court (STF).
c2270800.porQueImporta: It changes how lawmakers can be prosecuted; the Chamber approved it and the Senate rejected it on 09/24/2025.

c2563273.titulo: Requires Congress's approval for a digital currency or ending paper money
c2563273.oQueMuda: Creating a Central Bank digital currency or ending paper money would need approval from Congress.
c2563273.porQueImporta: It ensures cash isn't abolished without Congress's approval.

c2145273.titulo: Adds long-term care to social security
c2145273.oQueMuda: People who depend on long-term care would have this support as a social security right, with its own fund.
c2145273.quemAfeta: Dependent older people and people with disabilities, and their families.
c2145273.porQueImporta: It would create a right to ongoing care.

s8796560.titulo: Allows regional quotas at public universities
s8796560.oQueMuda: Public universities could adopt affirmative action based on geography in admissions.
s8796560.porQueImporta: It would change the competition for places.

s8823143.titulo: Guarantees maternity leave to women legislators
s8823143.oQueMuda: Women legislators would have the right to leave for pregnancy or adoption.
s8823143.porQueImporta: Today the Constitution has no clear rule for them.

s8834143.titulo: Gives the legislature power to create reserves and Indigenous lands
s8834143.oQueMuda: Environmental protection areas and Indigenous lands would require approval from Congress.
s8834143.quemAfeta: Indigenous peoples, farmers and environmental agencies.
s8834143.porQueImporta: Today this is done by the executive branch.

s8594291.titulo: Caps court-ordered debt payments and reopens city debt installment plans
s8594291.oQueMuda: States and municipalities would pay court-ordered debts ('precatórios') up to 1% to 5% of their revenue, depending on the size of the debt, and municipalities get a new deadline to pay pension debts in installments.
s8594291.quemAfeta: City and state governments, public servants and people owed court-ordered payments.
s8594291.porQueImporta: It eases the finances of indebted governments, but may lengthen the wait for people owed money by court order.
s8594291.apelido: Court-ordered debts and city debts amendment

c519258.oQueMuda: Creates a body for maritime, airport and border policing.
c519258.quemAfeta: The Federal Police and residents of border regions.
c519258.porQueImporta: Today these duties belong to the Federal Police.

c522713.titulo: Hands public safety in the Amazon to the federal government
c522713.oQueMuda: Public safety in the Legal Amazon would be the federal government's responsibility.
c522713.quemAfeta: Residents of the Legal Amazon, state police and the Federal Police.
c522713.porQueImporta: Today public safety is mainly the states' responsibility.

c505266.oQueMuda: Teenagers could be hired as regular employees from age 14.
c505266.porQueImporta: Today work is only allowed from 16, or from 14 as an apprentice.

c579916.oQueMuda: Lowers the minimum age to work.
c579916.porQueImporta: Today work is only allowed from 16, or from 14 as an apprentice.

c1527035.oQueMuda: Teenagers over 15 would have the right to work.
c1527035.porQueImporta: Today work is only allowed from 16, or from 14 as an apprentice.

c1598550.oQueMuda: Young people over 16 could be formally hired without being apprentices.
c1598550.porQueImporta: It would change the rules for hiring teenagers.

c1618127.porQueImporta: Today work is only allowed from 16, or from 14 as an apprentice.

c2236844.oQueMuda: The ban on any work would apply only to children under 13 (today it is 16, except apprentices from 14); night, dangerous or unhealthy work would remain banned before 18.
c2236844.quemAfeta: Teenagers aged 13 to 15, their families and employers.
c2236844.porQueImporta: It changes the minimum working age in the country.

c2231221.titulo: Allows public universities to charge tuition
c2231221.oQueMuda: Public universities could charge students tuition.
c2231221.quemAfeta: Public university students and their families.
c2231221.porQueImporta: Today public education is free at all levels.

c2341862.titulo: Allowed spending outside the cap in 2023 and changed budget amendments
c2341862.oQueMuda: Took expenses out of the spending cap for the 2023 budget and changed the rules for legislators' individual budget amendments.
c2341862.quemAfeta: The federal government, social program recipients and legislators.
c2341862.porQueImporta: It defined how much the government could spend in early 2023.

c2075880.titulo: Requires estimating the impact of new obligations on businesses
c2075880.oQueMuda: Laws creating or expanding obligations for economic sectors would need an estimate of the financial impact.
c2075880.porQueImporta: It would make the cost of new rules visible.

s8786193.titulo: Adjusts the Federal District fund by federal revenue
s8786193.oQueMuda: The Federal District's Constitutional Fund would be adjusted every year by the change in federal net revenue.
s8786193.quemAfeta: The government and residents of the Federal District.
s8786193.porQueImporta: The fund pays for security, health and education in the Federal District.

s8839624.titulo: Ends special court privileges when the term ends
s8839624.oQueMuda: Courts' power to try officials would end along with their term or office.
s8839624.quemAfeta: Politicians and officials with special court privileges.
s8839624.porQueImporta: Cases would go back to lower courts when the term ends.

c2086981.titulo: Changes how the vehicle tax (IPVA) is calculated
c2086981.oQueMuda: Creates a new tax base for the vehicle tax.
c2086981.porQueImporta: It could change how much IPVA is paid.

c2142844.titulo: Gives the armed forces border, port and airport policing
c2142844.oQueMuda: The armed forces would take on this policing role.
c2142844.quemAfeta: The armed forces and the Federal Police.
c2142844.porQueImporta: Today this is mainly the Federal Police's job.

s8856883.titulo: Adds the environment to foreign policy goals
s8856883.oQueMuda: Brazil's international relations would aim to promote environmental balance and sustainable development.
s8856883.porQueImporta: It would guide the country's agreements and positions.

c2544926.titulo: Lowers the retirement age for women police and officers
c2544926.oQueMuda: Women police officers, prison officers and juvenile detention officers could retire earlier.
c2544926.porQueImporta: It changes rules from the 2019 pension reform.

c351184.oQueMuda: Creates a police force for ports, which could absorb port guards.
c351184.porQueImporta: It changes security at the country's ports.

s7804756.titulo: Defines education as the engine of the country's progress
s7804756.oQueMuda: Adds to the Constitution that education drives Brazil's progress.
s7804756.porQueImporta: It is a change of principle that guides laws and policies.

c486477.titulo: Grants job security to long-serving workers hired under the CLT
c486477.oQueMuda: Civil servants hired under the CLT who were working when the unified legal regime was created would gain tenure.
c486477.quemAfeta: This group of long-serving civil servants.
c486477.porQueImporta: It would ensure they can't be dismissed without due process.

c2262083.titulo: Administrative reform of the civil service
c2262083.oQueMuda: Changes rules on hiring, tenure, evaluation and organization of civil servants and public employees.
c2262083.quemAfeta: Current and future civil servants and people who use public services.
c2262083.porQueImporta: It affects the structure of the civil service nationwide.

s8574119.titulo: Guarantees a minimum budget for Defense
s8574119.oQueMuda: The Ministry of Defense would have a guaranteed minimum budget and protected strategic projects.
s8574119.quemAfeta: The armed forces and the federal budget.
s8574119.porQueImporta: It would reduce flexibility to cut defense spending.

c2326575.titulo: Makes digital inclusion a fundamental right
c2326575.oQueMuda: Internet access and digital inclusion would become fundamental rights.
c2326575.quemAfeta: People without internet access and the government.
c2326575.porQueImporta: It requires the state to expand digital access.

c464909.titulo: Creates a single national career for public doctors
c464909.oQueMuda: Sets guidelines for a national career for doctors in public service.
c464909.quemAfeta: Doctors and patients of the public health system (SUS).
c464909.porQueImporta: It aims to bring doctors to regions that lack them.

c356309.titulo: Changes rules for creating or merging municipalities
c356309.oQueMuda: Creating, merging or splitting municipalities would have to preserve historical and cultural unity and happen up to 12 months before elections.
c356309.quemAfeta: Residents of areas seeking to become a municipality.
c356309.porQueImporta: It defines how new cities can be formed.

c2209776.titulo: Gives health insurance to former Sucam workers exposed to DDT
c2209776.oQueMuda: Former employees who handled the pesticide DDT would be entitled to health insurance.
c2209776.quemAfeta: Former employees of the old Sucam agency.
c2209776.porQueImporta: It aims to make up for health damage caused by their work.

s8563075.titulo: Guarantees inclusive education at all levels
s8563075.oQueMuda: Adds inclusive and accessible education as a principle of teaching.
s8563075.quemAfeta: Students with disabilities or specific needs, and schools.
s8563075.porQueImporta: It strengthens the duty to adapt teaching.

c1618422.titulo: Restores income tax exemption for retirees over 65
c1618422.oQueMuda: It brings back an old rule that exempted from income tax, within legal limits, pensions of people over 65 who live only on that income.
c1618422.porQueImporta: It would reduce the tax paid by this group and federal revenue.

c2140425.oQueMuda: Public consultations would take place on election day.
c2140425.porQueImporta: It would reduce the cost of consultations.

c2084889.titulo: Requires Congress's approval for heads of state-owned companies
c2084889.oQueMuda: Presidents and directors of federal companies would have to be approved by Congress.
c2084889.quemAfeta: State-owned companies such as Petrobras and public banks.
c2084889.porQueImporta: It expands Congress's control over these appointments.

c460138.titulo: Creates a fund to maintain the public safety system
c460138.oQueMuda: Creates a fund for maintaining and developing public safety.
c460138.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for the area.

c540302.titulo: Creates a national system and minimum spending on public safety
c540302.oQueMuda: Federal and state governments would have to spend minimum percentages on public safety.
c540302.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for the area.

c568527.titulo: Requires recorded votes on provisional measures
c568527.oQueMuda: Each legislator would have to record their vote on provisional measures (executive decrees).
c568527.porQueImporta: It would let people know how each one voted.

c2519865.titulo: Lets states make laws protecting older people
c2519865.oQueMuda: Federal and state governments would share the power to make laws protecting older people.
c2519865.porQueImporta: States could create their own protection rules.

s1399166.titulo: Lets states make laws protecting older people
s1399166.oQueMuda: Federal and state governments would share the power to make laws protecting older people.
s1399166.porQueImporta: States could create their own protection rules.

s8834618.oQueMuda: The word 'agrotóxicos' would be replaced by 'pesticidas' in the constitutional text.
s8834618.porQueImporta: It changes how these products are named in law.

s8834813.titulo: Bans freezing science and technology fund money
s8834813.oQueMuda: Spending from the National Science and Technology Development Fund (FNDCT) could not be frozen by the government.
s8834813.porQueImporta: It would guarantee money for scientific research.

s8255099.oQueMuda: The President, governors and mayors could not be reelected and would serve five-year terms.
s8255099.quemAfeta: Voters and heads of the executive branch.

s8794275.titulo: Cuts social security contributions for inland cities
s8794275.oQueMuda: Inland city governments would pay lower contributions on their payroll.
s8794275.quemAfeta: Inland city governments and social security.
s8794275.porQueImporta: It eases city finances and reduces social security revenue.

c489897.titulo: Gives union confederations part of union dues
c489897.oQueMuda: National union confederations would receive part of union dues.
c489897.porQueImporta: It affects how unions are funded.

c2503919.titulo: Makes basic sanitation a social right
c2503919.oQueMuda: Clean water and sewage would be listed among social rights.
c2503919.quemAfeta: People without sanitation and the government.
c2503919.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to bring sanitation to everyone.

s8309893.titulo: Creates a minimum salary for physical and occupational therapists
s8309893.oQueMuda: Establishes a national minimum salary for these professions.
s8309893.quemAfeta: Physical therapists, occupational therapists and employers.

s1395667.titulo: Makes basic sanitation a social right
s1395667.oQueMuda: Clean water and sewage would be listed among social rights.
s1395667.quemAfeta: People without sanitation and the government.
s1395667.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to bring sanitation to everyone.

s7849279.titulo: Creates a fund to repair environmental damage from mining and oil
s7849279.oQueMuda: 1% of federal revenue from oil, gas and minerals would go to preventing and repairing environmental damage.
s7849279.porQueImporta: It would create a steady source for disaster prevention.

c2499794.titulo: Creates a minimum salary for police and firefighters
c2499794.oQueMuda: Civil police, military police and firefighters would have a national minimum salary.
c2499794.quemAfeta: Police officers, firefighters and state governments.
c2499794.porQueImporta: It affects state spending and these workers' pay.

c2435133.titulo: Creates a special regime to rebuild Rio Grande do Sul
c2435133.oQueMuda: Relaxes fiscal and procurement rules to deal with the flood disaster and support affected families.
c2435133.quemAfeta: Residents and the government of Rio Grande do Sul.
c2435133.porQueImporta: It would speed up reconstruction spending.

c2231888.titulo: Guarantees income for families in poverty
c2231888.oQueMuda: Adds to the Constitution an anti-poverty policy with cash transfers to poor families.
c2231888.quemAfeta: Families in poverty and extreme poverty.
c2231888.porQueImporta: It would make a cash transfer program permanent.

s8796486.titulo: Allows a regional bonus for admission to public higher education
s8796486.oQueMuda: Public institutions could give a bonus to applicants from poorer regions.
s8796486.porQueImporta: It aims to reduce regional inequality in access.

c1738895.titulo: Sets rules and deadlines for creating municipalities
c1738895.oQueMuda: Sets procedures and timing for creating, merging or splitting municipalities.
c1738895.quemAfeta: Residents of districts and state governments.
c1738895.porQueImporta: Creating new cities is stalled for lack of this rule.

c598858.titulo: Adds maritime policing to military police duties
c598858.oQueMuda: Military police would also patrol coastal waters.
c598858.porQueImporta: It expands the military police's role.

c263327.oQueMuda: Changes rules on union registration, collective bargaining and worker representation.

c277153.titulo: Ends the single-union rule and creates a bargaining fee
c277153.oQueMuda: Allows more than one union per category, creates a collective bargaining fee and workplace representation.
c277153.porQueImporta: It would change the country's union model.

c292210.titulo: Renames collective labor disputes as 'normative actions'
c292210.oQueMuda: Collective cases in the Labor Courts would be called normative actions, filed by unions.
c292210.porQueImporta: It changes how collective disputes reach the courts.

c489621.titulo: Gives states back the power to create municipalities
c489621.oQueMuda: States could again make laws on creating, merging and splitting municipalities.
c489621.quemAfeta: Residents of districts seeking independence and state governments.
c489621.porQueImporta: Today creating cities depends on a federal law that was never passed.

c502631.titulo: Changes rules for creating or merging municipalities
c502631.oQueMuda: Creating, merging or splitting municipalities would have to preserve historical and cultural unity and happen up to 12 months before elections.
c502631.quemAfeta: Residents of areas seeking to become a municipality.
c502631.porQueImporta: It defines how new cities can be formed.

c2162097.titulo: Bars judges from cases tied to whoever appointed them
c2162097.oQueMuda: Judges could not take part in cases involving the president or governor who appointed them.
c2162097.quemAfeta: Judges and justices appointed by the executive.
c2162097.porQueImporta: It aims to avoid conflicts of interest in the courts.

c2233327.titulo: Makes it easier to change municipal borders
c2233327.oQueMuda: Sets rules to split, merge or redraw municipal borders without creating new cities.
c2233327.quemAfeta: Residents of border areas and city governments.
c2233327.porQueImporta: It settles territorial disputes between cities.

s8809676.titulo: Sends part of the education payroll contribution to public daycare
s8809676.oQueMuda: States and cities would have to use a share of the education payroll contribution to open and run daycare centers.
s8809676.quemAfeta: Young children, families and city governments.
s8809676.porQueImporta: It aims to increase daycare places.

s8540294.titulo: Changes rules for active-duty military running for office
s8540294.oQueMuda: Members of the armed forces who want to run would have to move to the reserve when registering as candidates.
s8540294.porQueImporta: It further separates military careers from politics.

c2487390.titulo: Expands audit court oversight of multinational companies with federal stakes
c2487390.oQueMuda: Congress and the federal audit court (TCU) could audit supranational companies in which the federal government has a stake.
c2487390.porQueImporta: It expands control over public money invested in these companies.

s8808203.titulo: Requires anyone summoned to appear before inquiry committees
s8808203.oQueMuda: Citizens and officials summoned by parliamentary inquiry committees would have to appear.
s8808203.quemAfeta: People summoned by parliamentary inquiry committees.
s8808203.porQueImporta: It increases the investigative power of these committees.

c348335.titulo: Ties pension increases to the minimum wage
c348335.oQueMuda: Social security benefits would get the same increase as the minimum wage, and the cap would rise to ten minimum wages.
c348335.quemAfeta: Retirees and pensioners of the national social security system (INSS).
c348335.porQueImporta: It would raise benefits and social security spending.

c1738778.titulo: Exempts police hazard bonuses from taxes
c1738778.oQueMuda: Hazard and life-risk bonuses paid to police would not be taxed.
c1738778.porQueImporta: It would raise the group's take-home pay.

c2018276.titulo: Sets priority and urgency criteria in health care
c2018276.oQueMuda: Keeps the universal right to health but sets criteria to define priorities and emergencies.
c2018276.quemAfeta: Patients of the public health system (SUS).
c2018276.porQueImporta: It affects the order of care in waiting lists.

c2189436.titulo: Adds academic freedom to fundamental rights
c2189436.oQueMuda: Teachers' and researchers' freedom to teach and express scientific ideas would be a fundamental right.
c2189436.porQueImporta: It strengthens protection of academic freedom.

c2307037.titulo: Makes basic income a social right
c2307037.oQueMuda: Basic income for vulnerable people would be listed among social rights.
c2307037.porQueImporta: It would give constitutional backing to cash transfer programs.

c1738617.titulo: Ends the stay-on bonus for civil servants
c1738617.oQueMuda: Civil servants who can already retire but keep working would stop receiving this bonus.
c1738617.porQueImporta: It cuts spending but may lead to earlier retirements.

c2057623.titulo: Changes the share of funds sent to the BNDES
c2057623.oQueMuda: Changes the share of PIS/PASEP money passed to the national development bank (BNDES) for loans.
c2057623.quemAfeta: The BNDES and companies that borrow from it.
c2057623.porQueImporta: It affects the volume of development credit.

c2233640.titulo: Allows city fire brigades with volunteers
c2233640.oQueMuda: Cities could create fire brigades through agreements with volunteer firefighters.

c2344523.titulo: Cuts property tax (IPTU) on land with native vegetation
c2344523.oQueMuda: The urban property tax would have environmental criteria, and areas with native vegetation would be tax-free.
c2344523.quemAfeta: Owners of urban property with preserved woodland and city governments.
c2344523.porQueImporta: It encourages preserving green areas in cities.

c2220682.titulo: Bans extra perks on top public salaries
c2220682.oQueMuda: Officials earning more than a quarter of a Supreme Court justice's salary could not receive add-ons without express provision.
c2220682.quemAfeta: Civil servants and officials with high salaries.
c2220682.porQueImporta: It aims to curb payments above the salary cap.

c458500.titulo: Merges civil and military police and demilitarizes firefighters
c458500.oQueMuda: Creates a single state police force replacing civil and military police and makes firefighters civilian.
c458500.quemAfeta: Police officers, firefighters and municipal guards.
c458500.porQueImporta: It would reorganize all police forces.

c2165018.titulo: Bans recent party membership for electoral court members
c2165018.oQueMuda: People serving in the electoral courts could not have been party members in the previous two years.
c2165018.quemAfeta: Judges and lawyers who sit on electoral courts.
c2165018.porQueImporta: It aims to ensure impartial elections.

c2221671.oQueMuda: Postal services could be run by private companies under authorization or concession.
c2221671.quemAfeta: The postal service (Correios), its employees and users.
c2221671.porQueImporta: Today postal service is exclusive to the federal government.

c2139404.titulo: Caps interest payments on the public debt
c2139404.oQueMuda: Sets a limit on what the federal government spends on interest and debt charges.
c2139404.quemAfeta: The federal government and the country's creditors.
c2139404.porQueImporta: It affects one of the largest items in the budget.

c2181063.titulo: Reduces the number of senators and deputies
c2181063.oQueMuda: Reduces the number of senators, federal deputies and state deputies.
c2181063.porQueImporta: It would change the size of the legislature and states' representation.

c110958.titulo: Establishes full freedom of association for unions
c110958.oQueMuda: Changes union organization rules, allowing more freedom to create organizations.
c110958.porQueImporta: It would change the country's union model.

c423901.titulo: Gives the Labor Courts power to try labor crimes
c423901.oQueMuda: Crimes such as slave labor and crimes against labor organization would be tried by the Labor Courts.
c423901.quemAfeta: Workers, employers and the federal courts.
c423901.porQueImporta: It changes which court tries these crimes.

c2487818.titulo: Allows summoning the Central Bank president
c2487818.oQueMuda: The Central Bank president could be summoned by the Chamber, the Senate or their committees.

c2487249.titulo: Guarantees lawyers the right to argue in person or online
c2487249.oQueMuda: Strengthens the lawyer's role and guarantees the right to speak at hearings, in person or online.
c2487249.porQueImporta: It affects the right of defense in the courts.

s8664217.titulo: Makes the Mato Grosso do Sul Pantanal national heritage
s8664217.oQueMuda: The Pantanal of Mato Grosso do Sul would be added to the national heritage areas.
s8664217.quemAfeta: Residents and producers in the Pantanal.
s8664217.porQueImporta: It strengthens environmental protection of the biome.

s8771508.titulo: Lowers the new tax on water and sewage
s8771508.oQueMuda: Changes the tax reform to reduce IBS and CBS rates on water and sewage services.
s8771508.porQueImporta: It could prevent higher water bills.

s7817905.oQueMuda: Children would be a social security priority, with a monthly benefit for those living in poverty.
s7817905.porQueImporta: It would create a permanent benefit for children.

s8403373.titulo: Exempts rare disease medicines from taxes
s8403373.oQueMuda: Medicines to treat rare diseases would be tax-free.
s8403373.quemAfeta: Patients with rare diseases and their families.
s8403373.porQueImporta: It could lower the price of these usually very expensive medicines.

s8477226.titulo: Requires a National Food Security Plan
s8477226.oQueMuda: The Constitution would require a national plan against hunger and for good nutrition.
s8477226.porQueImporta: It gives constitutional backing to anti-hunger policies.

s8656750.titulo: Creates the National Climate Emergency Fund
s8656750.oQueMuda: Creates a fund to guarantee money for floods, droughts and other climate disasters.
s8656750.porQueImporta: It would speed up the response to disasters.

s8542259.titulo: Makes possession of any amount of drugs a crime
s8542259.oQueMuda: The Constitution would require that unauthorized possession and carrying of drugs be a crime in any amount, distinguishing users from traffickers and providing alternatives to prison and treatment for users.
s8542259.quemAfeta: Drug users and the justice system.
s8542259.porQueImporta: It responds to a Supreme Court ruling that decriminalized possession of marijuana for personal use.

c2075449.titulo: Extends maternity leave for premature births
c2075449.oQueMuda: Time the premature baby spends in hospital would not be deducted from maternity leave.
c2075449.quemAfeta: Mothers of premature babies and employers.
c2075449.porQueImporta: It guarantees more time with the baby after discharge.

s8792757.titulo: Cuts the workweek to 40 hours and 5 days
s8792757.oQueMuda: The maximum would drop from 44 to 40 hours, over up to 5 days and 8 hours a day, with days off preferably on weekends.
s8792757.porQueImporta: It would end the 6-day schedule for many workers.

c2483164.oQueMuda: The president would appoint a prime minister to govern, and deputies would be elected by a mixed district system.
c2483164.porQueImporta: It would change the system of government and how deputies are elected.

c2229938.titulo: Speeds up the end of cases by limiting appeals
c2229938.oQueMuda: Appeals to the Supreme Court and the Superior Court of Justice would become review actions, and second-instance rulings would be final.
c2229938.quemAfeta: Defendants, parties to cases and higher courts.
c2229938.porQueImporta: It would allow sentences to be served after a second-instance ruling.

s1395980.titulo: Allows Congress to summon heads of state companies and agencies
s1395980.oQueMuda: The Chamber, the Senate and committees could summon heads of federal indirect administration bodies.
s1395980.quemAfeta: Heads of state-owned companies, agencies and authorities.

c14493.titulo: Lowers the age of criminal responsibility to 16
c14493.oQueMuda: Young people from 16 would be tried as adults.
c14493.quemAfeta: Teenagers aged 16 and 17 and the justice system.
c14493.porQueImporta: Today the age of criminal responsibility is 18.

c516111.titulo: Changes the process for provisional measures
c516111.oQueMuda: Changes deadlines and review steps for provisional measures (executive decrees) and bans reissuing them.
c516111.porQueImporta: It changes the government's power to create rules with immediate effect.

c786713.titulo: Unifies disability retirement rules for civil servants
c786713.oQueMuda: Sets the same rule for disability retirement and a transition for those who joined the civil service by 2003.
c786713.porQueImporta: It affects the amount of disability retirement.

c946494.oQueMuda: The government would have to carry out deputies' and senators' individual budget amendments.
c946494.quemAfeta: Legislators, cities and the federal government.
c946494.porQueImporta: It reduces the government's power to choose what to pay.

c1526944.titulo: Creates a special regime to pay overdue court debts
c1526944.oQueMuda: Sets rules for paying governments' court-ordered debts and a special regime for overdue cases.
c1526944.quemAfeta: People and companies that won lawsuits against governments.
c1526944.porQueImporta: It affects when these creditors get paid.

c2209349.titulo: Makes state caucus budget amendments mandatory
c2209349.oQueMuda: The government would have to carry out the collective budget amendments of state caucuses.
c2209349.quemAfeta: Legislators, states and the federal government.
c2209349.porQueImporta: It reduces the government's power to choose what to pay.

c606656.titulo: Adds human rights to the principles of the economy
c606656.oQueMuda: The economic order would have to respect human rights.

s8735431.titulo: Changes rules for inquiries opened by courts
s8735431.oQueMuda: Sets when courts can open inquiries into crimes at their premises or against their members.
s8735431.quemAfeta: Courts, especially the Supreme Court, and people under investigation.
