s8735431.porQueImporta: It limits the judiciary opening its own inquiries.

s8735562.titulo: Creates disciplinary complaints against Supreme Court justices
s8735562.oQueMuda: Supreme Court justices could face disciplinary complaints for conduct outside impeachable offenses.
s8735562.porQueImporta: Today no body can discipline them.

s8739428.titulo: Changes the makeup of the Electoral Court and removes Supreme Court justices from it
s8739428.oQueMuda: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) would have 7 members with 2-year terms: 2 justices of the Superior Court of Justice (STJ), 1 lawyer nominated by the Bar Association and appointed by the president, 2 chosen by the Chamber and 2 by the Senate.
s8739428.quemAfeta: The Electoral Court, the Supreme Court, Congress and voters.
s8739428.porQueImporta: It changes who runs the court that organizes and rules on elections.

s8749240.titulo: Changes rules for approving and paying budget amendments
s8749240.oQueMuda: Creates criteria for approving and paying legislators' amendments to budget laws.
s8749240.porQueImporta: It affects the transparency and control of this money.

s8772231.titulo: Creates technical criteria for choosing federal audit court ministers
s8772231.oQueMuda: Requires technical criteria and bans appointing recent politicians and relatives to the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU).
s8772231.porQueImporta: It aims to make the choice of public-accounts auditors more technical.

s8776422.titulo: Creates gender parity in judges' promotions
s8776422.oQueMuda: Guarantees quotas for women in promoting judges to appeals courts.
s8776422.porQueImporta: It aims to increase the number of women on the courts.

s8780865.titulo: Removes gang and militia homicides from jury trials
s8780865.oQueMuda: Crimes against life committed by members of criminal organizations and militias would not go to a jury.
s8780865.quemAfeta: Defendants linked to organized crime and jurors.
s8780865.porQueImporta: It aims to protect jurors from intimidation.

c2428346.oQueMuda: The right to receive care, such as for older and dependent people, would be listed among social rights.
c2428346.quemAfeta: People who need care and those who care for them.
c2428346.porQueImporta: It would support public care policies.

c348719.titulo: Tax reform with a financial transactions tax
c348719.oQueMuda: Creates selective taxes, a financial transactions tax of up to 0.76%, and ends the CSLL and the large fortunes tax.
c348719.quemAfeta: All taxpayers, states and the federal government.
c348719.porQueImporta: It would change the country's tax structure.

c355705.titulo: Increases the share of vehicle tax (IPVA) kept by cities
c355705.oQueMuda: Cities would get a bigger share of the IPVA from vehicles registered in their territory.
c355705.porQueImporta: It would change how this tax is split between states and cities.

c357691.oQueMuda: No taxes could be created on producing and selling essential foods.
c357691.porQueImporta: It could make the basic food basket cheaper.

c360826.titulo: Cuts the IPI tax on products made from recycled material
c360826.oQueMuda: Manufactured goods using recycled material would pay less IPI.
c360826.porQueImporta: It encourages the use of recycled material.

c370136.titulo: Exempts people with disabilities from income and property taxes
c370136.oQueMuda: People with disabilities would not pay taxes on their income or on buying and selling goods for their own use.
c370136.porQueImporta: It would increase this group's disposable income.

c370580.titulo: Rewards states and cities with conservation areas
c370580.oQueMuda: Up to 0.5% of participation fund transfers would go to states and cities with environmental conservation areas.
c370580.quemAfeta: States and cities with protected areas.
c370580.porQueImporta: It creates a financial incentive to preserve.

c370778.titulo: Creates a rural support fund from federal transfers
c370778.oQueMuda: 3% of federal revenue sent to cities would go to a special fund supporting agriculture.
c370778.porQueImporta: It would guarantee funding for local agriculture.

c383286.titulo: Defines where money from new federal taxes goes
c383286.oQueMuda: Sets where the revenue from any new or increased federal tax would go.
c383286.porQueImporta: It limits the free use of new revenue.

c384058.titulo: Changes compensation to states for exports
c384058.oQueMuda: Changes the compensation the federal government pays states for losses from tax exemptions on exports.

c384059.titulo: Bans social contributions on government revenue
c384059.oQueMuda: The federal government, states, the Federal District, municipalities and public agencies would no longer pay social contributions on revenue, such as PIS/Pasep.
c384059.quemAfeta: All levels of government and the social security system, which receives these contributions.
c384059.porQueImporta: It would ease state and city finances but reduce social security funding.

c384060.titulo: Splits sales tax on online purchases between states
c384060.oQueMuda: In online sales between states, part of the ICMS would go to the buyer's state.
c384060.porQueImporta: It would change each state's revenue from e-commerce.

c384544.titulo: Cuts taxes on machinery and equipment
c384544.oQueMuda: Capital goods, such as industrial machines, would be exempt from IPI and ICMS.

c384954.titulo: Creates a federal VAT by merging contributions
c384954.oQueMuda: Combines Cofins, PIS and Cide into a value-added tax and folds the CSLL into corporate income tax.

c389981.oQueMuda: Creates a minimum tax on financial transactions and transfers.
c389981.quemAfeta: Everyone who moves money through banks.
c389981.porQueImporta: It would be similar to the old CPMF.

c391353.oQueMuda: Employers would stop paying social contributions on salaries.
c391353.porQueImporta: It would lower the cost of hiring and require another source for social security.

c440021.titulo: Creates a single tax on goods and services
c440021.oQueMuda: Creates a non-cumulative tax on transactions with goods or services, including imports.
c440021.porQueImporta: It would change how consumption is taxed.

c604132.titulo: Creates a welfare benefit for crime victims
c604132.oQueMuda: Crime victims would be entitled to a social assistance benefit.
c604132.porQueImporta: It would give financial support to people who suffered violence.

c1229857.titulo: Ends the benefit for prisoners' families
c1229857.oQueMuda: The benefit paid to prisoners' dependents would be removed from social security.
c1229857.porQueImporta: It would take away an income source from these families.

c1712462.titulo: Gives a monthly benefit to dependents of homicide victims
c1712462.oQueMuda: Dependents of people who were murdered would receive one minimum wage a month.
c1712462.porQueImporta: It would create financial support for these families.

c2113815.titulo: Swaps the prisoners' family benefit for one for victims' families
c2113815.oQueMuda: Ends the benefit for prisoners' families and gives one minimum wage a month to dependents of homicide victims.
c2113815.quemAfeta: Families of prisoners and of homicide victims.
c2113815.porQueImporta: It changes who receives state support.

c2140762.titulo: Ties the prisoners' family benefit to the prisoner working
c2140762.oQueMuda: The benefit for dependents would only be paid if the convicted prisoner works.
c2140762.porQueImporta: It would change access to this benefit.

c2474283.oQueMuda: Changes rules on super-salaries, the BPC disability and elderly benefit, the Fundeb education fund and the wage bonus, and extends the DRU to 2032.
c2474283.quemAfeta: Civil servants, BPC and wage bonus recipients, and basic education.
c2474283.porQueImporta: It is part of the effort to control the growth of public spending.

c14638.titulo: Cuts the workweek from 44 to 30 hours
c14638.oQueMuda: The workweek would drop one hour a year down to 30 hours, with agreements allowing up to 40.
c14638.porQueImporta: It would change the work routine of millions of people.

c378195.titulo: Ties pension increases to the minimum wage
c378195.oQueMuda: The minimum wage would be the benchmark for adjusting social security benefits and their real value.
c378195.quemAfeta: Retirees and pensioners of the national social security system (INSS).
c378195.porQueImporta: It would raise benefits above the minimum and social security spending.

c539564.titulo: Guarantees pensions the same increase as the minimum wage
c539564.oQueMuda: No social security benefit could rise less than the minimum wage, and current ones would be updated.
c539564.quemAfeta: Retirees and pensioners of the national social security system.
c539564.porQueImporta: It would raise benefits and social security spending.

c543447.titulo: Protects the real value of pensions
c543447.oQueMuda: Pensions and social security benefits would be guaranteed to keep their purchasing power.
c543447.porQueImporta: It would prevent losses from inflation.

c1228532.titulo: Bans moving to lighter prison regimes for heinous crimes and trafficking
c1228532.oQueMuda: People convicted of torture, drug trafficking, terrorism and heinous crimes would serve the whole sentence in the same regime.
c1228532.quemAfeta: People convicted of these crimes and the prison system.
c1228532.porQueImporta: It would end moves to lighter regimes in these cases.

c2155899.titulo: Toughens sentences for heinous crimes against military and police
c2155899.oQueMuda: Heinous crimes against military personnel, police and their families would have harsher sentencing rules.
c2155899.quemAfeta: Security agents, their families and convicts.
c2155899.porQueImporta: It aims to protect people who work in security.

s8635009.oQueMuda: Changes the bodies and powers of federal and state military courts.
s8635009.quemAfeta: Military personnel and the military courts.
s8635009.porQueImporta: It affects how military personnel are tried.

c336945.titulo: Allows municipal guards in state capitals to protect people
c336945.oQueMuda: State capitals could have guards to protect people and private property, alongside the military police.
c336945.quemAfeta: Municipal guards and residents of capitals.

c528631.titulo: Limits politicians' raises to the minimum wage increase
c528631.oQueMuda: Salaries of legislators, executives and listed officials could not rise more than the minimum wage.
c528631.porQueImporta: It limits raises in these salaries.

c578465.oQueMuda: Creates a civil police in cities and redefines the military police's duties.
c578465.porQueImporta: It would change the organization of public safety.

c2086167.oQueMuda: Cities could have police for patrolling and public order, using municipal guards.
c2086167.porQueImporta: It expands cities' role in policing.

c2120463.titulo: Freezes elected officials' salaries for 5 years
c2120463.oQueMuda: Salaries of people holding elected office could not rise for five years.
c2120463.porQueImporta: It would reduce spending on these salaries.

c2166332.titulo: Adds municipal police to public safety
c2166332.oQueMuda: Municipal police forces would become part of the public safety bodies.
c2166332.porQueImporta: It expands cities' role in policing.

c2174544.titulo: Adds municipal guards to public safety
c2174544.oQueMuda: Municipal guards would officially become part of the public safety bodies.
c2174544.porQueImporta: It expands cities' role in public safety.

c2227277.titulo: Requires cities over 20,000 people to have a municipal guard
c2227277.oQueMuda: Every city with 20,000 or more residents would have to create a municipal guard.
c2227277.porQueImporta: It would create a new mandatory expense for cities.

c2314519.titulo: Requires reinvesting concession money in transport
c2314519.oQueMuda: At least 70% of what is paid for transport concessions would have to be reinvested in the sector.
c2314519.quemAfeta: Users of highways, ports and railways, and the government.
c2314519.porQueImporta: It guarantees funding for transport infrastructure.

c2350490.oQueMuda: Culture would be listed among social rights.
c2350490.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty toward cultural policy.

c597232.titulo: Changes the makeup and oversight of audit courts
c597232.oQueMuda: Changes how audit court members are chosen and places them under the CNJ and CNMP councils.
c597232.porQueImporta: It creates oversight of those who oversee public accounts.

c2478427.titulo: Expands legislators' immunity for what they say
c2478427.oQueMuda: Deputies and senators could not be punished for opinions anywhere, and a Supreme Court justice who disregards this would lose office.
c2478427.porQueImporta: It affects the line between parliamentary freedom and accountability.

c2190000.titulo: Increases federal transfers to the FPM
c2190000.oQueMuda: An extra share of federal revenue, including CSLL and Cofins, would go to the Municipal Participation Fund.

c2228314.titulo: Increases the share of federal taxes sent to states and cities
c2228314.oQueMuda: Raises the shares of income tax and IPI revenue passed to states, the Federal District and cities.
c2228314.quemAfeta: States, cities and the federal government.
c2228314.porQueImporta: It would change how money is split among governments.

s8759356.titulo: Adds victims' rights to fundamental rights
s8759356.oQueMuda: Victims of crimes and disasters would have guaranteed rights, and the state a duty to protect them.
s8759356.porQueImporta: It strengthens state support for victims.

s8759452.titulo: Applies the salary cap to allowances too
s8759452.oQueMuda: The public sector salary cap would also apply to allowances and compensation payments.
s8759452.quemAfeta: Civil servants and officials with high salaries.
s8759452.porQueImporta: It aims to end payments above the cap.

c125854.titulo: Expands freedom of association for unions
c125854.oQueMuda: Changes rules on union organization and union contributions.
c125854.porQueImporta: It would change the union model.

c2350568.titulo: Requires Congress's approval for public bank loans abroad
c2350568.oQueMuda: Loans by the BNDES and other federal banks for projects abroad would depend on Congress.
c2350568.quemAfeta: Public banks and the federal government.
c2350568.porQueImporta: It expands control over these loans.

c2362646.titulo: Allows direct transfers of caucus amendments to states and cities
c2362646.oQueMuda: Individual and caucus budget amendments could be transferred directly, without formal agreements.
c2362646.porQueImporta: It speeds up transfers but reduces control over how money is used.

c2291133.titulo: Bans active-duty military from civilian government posts
c2291133.oQueMuda: Active-duty military could not hold civilian posts in public administration.
c2291133.porQueImporta: It separates the armed forces from civilian management.

c2238418.titulo: Requires collective Supreme Court decisions on injunctions
c2238418.oQueMuda: Injunctions in constitutional challenges would have to be decided by more than one justice.
c2238418.porQueImporta: It reduces a single justice's power to suspend laws.

s8204843.titulo: Transfers federal seaside land to states, cities and occupants
s8204843.oQueMuda: It abolishes 'marine land' (federal seaside strips): the federal government keeps land in federal use and unoccupied areas; states and municipalities receive areas used for their services; and registered occupants (or those there for at least 5 years) may become owners.
s8204843.quemAfeta: Coastal residents and businesses, states, municipalities and the federal government.
s8204843.porQueImporta: It changes who owns seaside land; part of the debate is about its effect on access to beaches.

c2336481.titulo: Allows direct election of the leadership of the largest state courts
c2336481.oQueMuda: In state Courts of Justice with more than 170 appellate judges, all of them would vote by secret ballot to choose the leadership, for 2-year terms with only one re-election.
c2336481.quemAfeta: Appellate judges in the largest state courts, such as São Paulo's.
c2336481.porQueImporta: It changes who chooses the leadership of these courts.

c543252.titulo: Guarantees the right to life from conception
c543252.oQueMuda: The Constitution would state that the right to life is inviolable from conception.
c543252.porQueImporta: It could affect the cases in which abortion is currently allowed by law.

c567421.titulo: Requires a referendum to sell control of state-owned companies
c567421.oQueMuda: Selling control of state-owned companies would require approval by voters in a referendum.

c1672707.titulo: Bans provisional measures that reduce labor rights
c1672707.oQueMuda: The President could not issue a provisional measure (executive decree) to reduce workers' rights.
c1672707.porQueImporta: Labor changes would require a law passed by Congress.

c2211748.titulo: Adds social workers, psychologists and nutritionists to schools
c2211748.oQueMuda: Public and private schools would have these professionals.
c2211748.porQueImporta: It expands student support beyond classes.

c2186256.titulo: Bans provisional measures on labor and pensions
c2186256.oQueMuda: The President could not issue a provisional measure (executive decree) on labor or pension law.
c2186256.porQueImporta: Changes in these areas would require a law passed by Congress.

s8743101.titulo: Allows summoning regulatory agencies to Congress
s8743101.oQueMuda: Heads of regulatory agencies and other federal bodies could be summoned to explain themselves.
s8743101.quemAfeta: Agencies such as Anatel, Aneel and ANS.

c591185.titulo: Simplifies pension contributions for waste pickers
c591185.oQueMuda: Waste pickers who work as a family would contribute to social security as special insured workers.
c591185.porQueImporta: It makes it easier for these workers to retire.

c1732943.titulo: Sets a deadline for Congress to rule on the President's accounts
c1732943.oQueMuda: Congress would have a deadline to rule on the presidential accounts, or the head of Congress would commit an impeachable offense.
c1732943.porQueImporta: It keeps accounts from going unreviewed for years.

s7730684.titulo: Creates 8-year terms for Supreme Court justices
s7730684.oQueMuda: Supreme Court justices would serve eight-year terms, with deadlines for nomination and approval.
s7730684.quemAfeta: Current and future Supreme Court justices.
s7730684.porQueImporta: Today the post is held for life until age 75.

c2448732.titulo: Lets Congress suspend Supreme Court rulings
c2448732.oQueMuda: Injunctions would have to be confirmed by the full court, and Congress could halt certain Supreme Court rulings.
c2448732.porQueImporta: It would shift the balance between the branches.

c2278136.titulo: Exempts vaccines from taxes in health emergencies
c2278136.oQueMuda: Vaccines and supplies against diseases under a national emergency would be tax-free for three years.
c2278136.quemAfeta: Vaccine makers and the public health system (SUS).
c2278136.porQueImporta: It could make vaccines cheaper in crises like COVID-19.

s8730454.titulo: Creates a long-term plan to guide the budget
s8730454.oQueMuda: A plan covering several four-year periods would guide federal spending and investment.
s8730454.porQueImporta: It aims to keep investments going across governments.

s8735524.titulo: Lets Congress halt acts of other branches
s8735524.oQueMuda: The legislature could annul executive and judicial rules that exceed their powers.
s8735524.quemAfeta: Congress, the government and the courts.
s8735524.porQueImporta: It expands Congress's power over the other branches.

c459294.titulo: Merges civil and military police and demilitarizes firefighters
c459294.oQueMuda: Creates a single state police force replacing civil and military police and makes firefighters civilian.
c459294.quemAfeta: Police officers, firefighters and municipal guards.
c459294.porQueImporta: It would reorganize all police forces.

c595169.oQueMuda: Adds new state and city police forces to the public safety bodies.
c595169.porQueImporta: It would change the organization of public safety.

c2212168.titulo: Limits spending on public debt payments
c2212168.oQueMuda: Adds a limit on public debt spending to the spending cap.
c2212168.porQueImporta: It affects one of the largest items in the budget.

s8719180.titulo: Guarantees compensation to police injured on duty
s8719180.oQueMuda: Police and state military personnel would be compensated for accidents or assaults suffered at work.
s8719180.quemAfeta: Police and military personnel of the states and the federal government.
s8719180.porQueImporta: It creates financial protection for these workers.

s8720944.titulo: Creates a financing fund for the South region
s8720944.oQueMuda: Creates a constitutional fund for the South, focused on Rio Grande do Sul's recovery after the floods.
s8720944.quemAfeta: Companies and residents of the South.
s8720944.porQueImporta: It would offer easier credit for reconstruction.

c1548995.titulo: Shares social contributions with states and cities
c1548995.oQueMuda: Part of CSLL and Cofins revenue would be passed on to states, the Federal District and cities.
c1548995.quemAfeta: States, cities and the federal government.
c1548995.porQueImporta: It would change how money is split among governments.

c2455515.titulo: Creates a national climate authority, council and fund
c2455515.oQueMuda: Creates the National Climate Change Council, the National Climate Authority and a federally funded fund.
c2455515.porQueImporta: It organizes the country's response to climate change.

c2352476.titulo: Pardons parties and reserves funds for Black candidates
c2352476.oQueMuda: Pardons parties that didn't meet gender and race quotas and requires 30% of funds for Black and brown candidates.
c2352476.porQueImporta: It affects penalties on parties and campaign financing.

s8705604.titulo: Guarantees lawyers the right to speak at any hearing
s8705604.oQueMuda: Lawyers would have the right to oral argument at any hearing in any court.
s8705604.porQueImporta: It affects the right of defense.

s8466340.titulo: Adds city attorneys to the public legal service
s8466340.oQueMuda: City attorneys would become part of the public legal service provided for in the Constitution.
s8466340.porQueImporta: It would require cities to have attorneys hired by public exam.

c2388029.titulo: Sets aside part of lawmakers' budget amendments for natural disasters
c2388029.oQueMuda: 5% of individual budget amendments from deputies and senators would go to disaster prevention and response, such as floods and droughts.
c2388029.quemAfeta: Municipalities hit by floods, droughts and landslides.
c2388029.porQueImporta: It guarantees money for climate emergencies within the existing budget.

c2448752.titulo: Defines life as beginning at conception
c2448752.oQueMuda: The Constitution would state that the right to life is inviolable from fertilization.
c2448752.porQueImporta: It could affect the cases in which abortion is currently allowed by law.

s8693939.oQueMuda: The government would have to carry out budget amendments made by congressional committees.
s8693939.porQueImporta: It reduces the government's power to choose what to pay.

s8693978.titulo: Creates the Rio Grande do Sul Free Trade Zone
s8693978.oQueMuda: Creates, for a set period, an area with tax benefits in Rio Grande do Sul.
s8693978.quemAfeta: Companies and residents of Rio Grande do Sul.
s8693978.porQueImporta: It aims to attract investment after the floods.

c2189078.titulo: Changes how the State Participation Fund is shared
c2189078.oQueMuda: Changes the rules for splitting the FPE among states and the Federal District.
c2189078.porQueImporta: The FPE is an important source of revenue for many states.

c2209439.titulo: Allows regional funds to pay for public works
c2209439.oQueMuda: Money from the North, Northeast and Center-West funds could finance public works.
c2209439.quemAfeta: States and cities in these regions.
c2209439.porQueImporta: Today these funds mainly finance companies.

s8582100.oQueMuda: Increases the length of maternity, paternity and adoption leave.

c2277279.titulo: Makes access to drinking water a fundamental right
c2277279.oQueMuda: Access to drinking water would be included among fundamental rights.
c2277279.quemAfeta: People without clean water and the government.
c2277279.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to guarantee water.

c2147461.titulo: Removes the time limit to prosecute rape
c2147461.oQueMuda: Rape could be punished at any time.
c2147461.quemAfeta: Victims and those accused of rape.
c2147461.porQueImporta: Today the crime expires after a certain period.

s7755772.titulo: Limits expropriations and requires market-price compensation
s7755772.oQueMuda: Expropriating urban and rural property would need approval from the legislature or a court, with payment at market value.
s7755772.quemAfeta: Owners, governments and housing and land movements.
s7755772.porQueImporta: It would make expropriation for failing the property's social function harder.

c2229539.titulo: Removes the time limit to prosecute rape and femicide
c2229539.oQueMuda: Rape and femicide would allow no bail and could be punished at any time.
c2229539.quemAfeta: Victims, their families and the accused.
c2229539.porQueImporta: Today these crimes expire after a certain period.

c451074.oQueMuda: People not affiliated with a party could run for office.
c451074.porQueImporta: Today you can only run through a party.

c2140427.oQueMuda: Defines how voters can revoke terms through a citizen initiative.
c2140427.porQueImporta: It would give voters a way to end terms.

c2145346.titulo: Allows independent candidates and civic lists
c2145346.oQueMuda: Candidates without a party could run with voter support and join civic lists.
c2145346.porQueImporta: Today you can only run through a party.

c2162013.titulo: Allows candidates without a party with support from 1% of voters
c2162013.oQueMuda: Anyone backed by 1% of voters could run without a party.
c2162013.porQueImporta: Today you can only run through a party.

c2226594.oQueMuda: The government would be led by a prime minister with the support of Congress.
c2226594.porQueImporta: It would change the country's system of government.

s8670175.oQueMuda: Sports would be listed among social rights.
s8670175.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty toward sports policy.

c2153455.oQueMuda: Creates security bodies for juvenile detention centers.
c2153455.quemAfeta: Juvenile detention staff and detained teenagers.

c2436619.titulo: Adds integration with Portuguese-speaking countries to foreign policy
c2436619.oQueMuda: Integration with Portuguese-speaking countries would be a principle of international relations.

s8655096.titulo: Creates a special fiscal regime for environmental disasters
s8655096.oQueMuda: Governments could relax fiscal and procurement rules to deal with regional or local disasters.
s8655096.quemAfeta: Residents of affected areas and governments.
s8655096.porQueImporta: It would speed up disaster response.

s8394295.titulo: Creates a length-of-service bonus for judges and prosecutors
s8394295.oQueMuda: Judges and prosecutors would receive an extra payment every five years of service.
s8394295.porQueImporta: It would raise salaries that are already among the highest in public service.

s8572569.titulo: Removes the time limit to prosecute child trafficking
s8572569.oQueMuda: Trafficking of children and teenagers could be punished at any time.
s8572569.quemAfeta: Victims and those accused of this crime.
s8572569.porQueImporta: Today the crime expires after a certain period.

c2329063.titulo: Bans cutting the armed forces' budget
c2329063.oQueMuda: Removes limits and bans freezes on armed forces funding.
c2329063.quemAfeta: The armed forces and the federal budget.
c2329063.porQueImporta: It reduces flexibility to cut spending.

s8060121.titulo: Makes air quality a fundamental right
s8060121.oQueMuda: Adds the right to breathe clean air, including in shared indoor spaces, to fundamental rights.
s8060121.porQueImporta: It strengthens the duty to control pollution.

s8646008.titulo: Changes small business taxation under the tax reform
s8646008.oQueMuda: Fixes rules of the new tax system for micro and small businesses and individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs).
s8646008.quemAfeta: Micro and small businesses and individual micro-entrepreneurs.
s8646008.porQueImporta: It could reduce these businesses' taxes and red tape.

s8644146.titulo: Sends part of tourism sales tax back to the sector
s8644146.oQueMuda: States would set aside a share of ICMS from tourism services to promote tourism.
s8644146.quemAfeta: The tourism sector and state governments.
s8644146.porQueImporta: It guarantees money to promote tourism.

s8639865.oQueMuda: Culture would be listed among social rights.
s8639865.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty toward cultural policy.

c2017887.titulo: Lets Congress halt acts of the judiciary
c2017887.oQueMuda: Congress could annul rules issued by the judiciary.
c2017887.porQueImporta: It would shift the balance between the branches.

c2207351.titulo: Lets Congress halt acts of the judiciary
c2207351.oQueMuda: Congress could annul judiciary rules it considers excessive.
c2207351.porQueImporta: It would shift the balance between the branches.

c344176.titulo: Extends special retirement to education professionals
c344176.oQueMuda: Those in teaching or teaching support would have five years off the required age and contribution time.
c344176.porQueImporta: It would let them retire earlier.

c400327.titulo: Counts teaching in hospitals and prisons as teaching service
c400327.oQueMuda: Teachers in hospitals, rehabilitation centers and prisons would have special retirement.
c400327.porQueImporta: It would let them retire earlier.

c415712.titulo: Ends the minimum retirement age for teachers
c415712.oQueMuda: Public school teachers could retire based only on contribution time, with no minimum age.

c489706.titulo: Counts time in former daycare centers toward retirement
c489706.oQueMuda: Early childhood teachers could count time worked in daycare centers before they joined school systems.

c2117201.titulo: Adds municipal guards to public safety
c2117201.oQueMuda: Municipal guards would become part of the public safety bodies, with retirement rights.
c2117201.porQueImporta: It expands cities' role in public safety.

c349704.titulo: Gives severance fund (FGTS) and unemployment insurance to political appointees
c349704.oQueMuda: Civil servants in freely appointed posts would be entitled to notice, the FGTS severance fund and unemployment insurance.
c349704.porQueImporta: Today they don't have these rights.

s7826575.oQueMuda: Fathers and mothers could alternate and share the days of maternity leave.
s7826575.porQueImporta: It would give families more freedom to organize baby care.

s7830951.titulo: Requires Congress's approval for Brazil to leave treaties
s7830951.oQueMuda: Brazil could only withdraw from an international treaty with Congress's prior approval.
s7830951.porQueImporta: Today the President can do this alone.

s7856184.titulo: Replaces maternity leave with 180-day parental leave
s7856184.oQueMuda: Creates a 180-day leave that fathers and mothers, including adoptive parents, could share.
s7856184.porQueImporta: It would change how baby care is shared.

c2024222.titulo: Broadens the definition of family in the Constitution
c2024222.oQueMuda: A family would be any group of two or more people joined by blood, affection, marriage or civil union.
c2024222.porQueImporta: It affects rights such as inheritance, pensions and benefits.

c2221375.titulo: Creates a fund for a possible state formed by merging with the former capital
c2221375.oQueMuda: Creates a constitutional fund for a federal unit resulting from a merger with the former capital and sets a 10-year limit for these funds.
c2221375.quemAfeta: Residents and the government of Rio de Janeiro.
c2221375.porQueImporta: It affects federal transfers tied to the country's former capital.

c2222665.titulo: Changes the rule on council members holding two jobs
c2222665.oQueMuda: Changes the rule that lets city council members combine their term with a job in city government.
c2222665.quemAfeta: City council members who are civil servants.
c2222665.porQueImporta: It affects who can hold two positions at once.

c2224677.titulo: Expands the state's duty in education
c2224677.oQueMuda: Adds a new state duty toward education and changes a school funding rule.

c2084719.titulo: Guarantees civil servants a yearly raise at least equal to inflation
c2084719.oQueMuda: The general annual salary review for civil servants could not be lower than inflation.
c2084719.porQueImporta: It would increase mandatory spending on staff.

s8412320.titulo: Makes food security a fundamental right
s8412320.oQueMuda: Access to adequate food would be listed as a social right.
s8412320.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to fight hunger.

s8623312.titulo: Expands legislators' immunity for their opinions
s8623312.oQueMuda: Reworks the rule so deputies and senators can't be punished for opinions and votes anywhere.
s8623312.porQueImporta: It affects the line between parliamentary freedom and accountability.

s8622879.titulo: Requires a verifiable printed ballot in elections
s8622879.oQueMuda: Voting machines would have to print a ballot the voter checks, which is kept for audits.
s8622879.porQueImporta: It would change the electronic voting system.

s8617172.titulo: Lowers the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for heinous crimes
s8617172.oQueMuda: 16 and 17-year-olds who commit heinous crimes would be tried as adults.
s8617172.porQueImporta: Today the age of criminal responsibility is 18.

s8620564.titulo: Lets Congress halt acts of the judiciary and councils
s8620564.oQueMuda: Congress could annul acts of courts and councils that exceed their powers.
s8620564.quemAfeta: Congress, the courts, the CNJ and the CNMP.
s8620564.porQueImporta: It would shift the balance between the branches.

c2196833.titulo: Tax reform: replaces five taxes with IBS and CBS
c2196833.oQueMuda: Replaces PIS, Cofins, IPI, ICMS and ISS with two consumption taxes, the IBS and the CBS, plus a selective tax.
c2196833.porQueImporta: It is the biggest change to consumption taxes since 1988; it became Constitutional Amendment 132.

s8403380.titulo: Adjusts federal transfers to cities for inflation
s8403380.oQueMuda: Amounts in federal agreements and programs with cities would be updated for inflation.
s8403380.porQueImporta: It keeps transfers from losing purchasing power.

c459272.titulo: Aligns the Constitution with the UN disability convention
c459272.oQueMuda: Updates several articles to follow the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.
c459272.porQueImporta: It modernizes terms and rights in the Constitution.

s8609290.oQueMuda: People not affiliated with a party could run for office.
s8609290.porQueImporta: Today you can only run through a party.

s8609795.titulo: Grants amnesty for the January 8 riots and restores rights and mandates
s8609795.oQueMuda: It grants amnesty to those involved in the January 8, 2023 riots, restores the rights of those made ineligible over 2022 election conduct and gives back revoked mandates.
s8609795.quemAfeta: People convicted or investigated over the riots and politicians declared ineligible or removed from office.
s8609795.porQueImporta: It would cancel penalties imposed by the courts in these cases.

s8610921.titulo: Ends secret votes in the legislature
s8610921.oQueMuda: All votes in Congress, state assemblies and city councils would be open.
s8610921.porQueImporta: It would show how each one voted on every decision.

c1555270.titulo: Makes accessibility and urban mobility social rights
c1555270.oQueMuda: Accessibility and urban mobility would be listed among social rights.
c1555270.quemAfeta: People with disabilities and urban transit users.
c1555270.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty toward these policies.

c2301270.oQueMuda: Accessibility and mobility would become fundamental rights.
c2301270.quemAfeta: People with disabilities or reduced mobility.
c2301270.porQueImporta: It strengthens the duty to adapt spaces and services.

c117100.titulo: Bans workplace discrimination based on sexual orientation and other grounds
c117100.oQueMuda: Bans differences in pay, role and hiring based on sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, politics or disability.

c2195689.titulo: Gives children with disabilities priority in early education
c2195689.oQueMuda: Children with disabilities would have priority for daycare and preschool places.
c2195689.quemAfeta: Children with disabilities and their families.
c2195689.porQueImporta: It affects the order of access to places.

c421307.titulo: Passes part of import tax to cities with customs zones
c421307.oQueMuda: 5% of the import tax would go to cities that host customs zones.
c421307.porQueImporta: It would increase these cities' revenue.

s8607959.titulo: Bars reducing a legal minimum wage by agreement
s8607959.oQueMuda: Minimum salaries set by law could not be reduced by collective agreements.
s8607959.quemAfeta: Workers with a legal minimum salary and employers.

c259094.oQueMuda: Changes several parts of the tax system, in a smaller version of tax reform.
c259094.quemAfeta: Taxpayers, states and the federal government.

c536019.titulo: Charges vehicle tax (IPVA) on planes, private jets and boats
c536019.oQueMuda: The IPVA would also apply to aircraft and boats.
c536019.quemAfeta: Owners of planes, helicopters, yachts and motorboats.
c536019.porQueImporta: Today these vehicles don't pay IPVA.

c582954.titulo: Expands the vehicle tax (IPVA) and creates exemptions
c582954.oQueMuda: The IPVA would apply to more vehicles and be banned in some situations.
c582954.porQueImporta: It would change who pays the tax.

c2081040.titulo: Sets a deadline to enact constitutional amendments
c2081040.oQueMuda: Approved amendments would have a deadline to be enacted.
c2081040.porQueImporta: It keeps approved amendments from going unenforced.

c2189052.titulo: Makes newly sworn-in deputies and senators lose any other office
c2189052.oQueMuda: On taking office as deputy or senator, a person would permanently lose any other elected office they held.
c2189052.quemAfeta: Officeholders who are elected to Congress.
c2189052.porQueImporta: It prevents returning to the previous post.

c2404706.titulo: Allows using leftover COVID funds for health
c2404706.oQueMuda: Leftover federal funds sent to fight the pandemic could be used for other health actions.
c2404706.quemAfeta: States, cities and patients of the public health system (SUS).
c2404706.porQueImporta: It frees money sitting in health funds.

c2406638.titulo: Creates a specific legal regime for police officers
c2406638.oQueMuda: Sets specific rules on careers, retirement and survivor pensions for police.
c2406638.porQueImporta: It affects the category's rights and retirement.

c2405983.titulo: Swaps payroll contributions for a transactions tax
c2405983.oQueMuda: Contributions on payroll and revenue would be replaced by a charge on financial transactions.
c2405983.porQueImporta: It would lower the cost of hiring and create a tax similar to the old CPMF.

c530024.titulo: Lets foreigners vote and run in municipal elections
c530024.oQueMuda: Foreigners living in Brazil could take part in municipal elections.
c530024.porQueImporta: Today foreigners can't vote in Brazil.

c599448.titulo: Lets foreigners who have lived in Brazil over four years vote
c599448.oQueMuda: Foreign residents with regular status living in Brazil for more than four years could vote.
c599448.porQueImporta: Today foreigners can't vote in Brazil.

c2162990.titulo: Gives voting rights to foreigners who have lived in Brazil over five years
c2162990.oQueMuda: Foreigners legally residing in Brazil for more than five years could vote.
c2162990.porQueImporta: Today foreigners can't vote in Brazil.

c2196315.titulo: Lets military personnel return to active duty after a term
c2196315.oQueMuda: Elected military personnel could return to active service when their term ends.
c2196315.quemAfeta: Military personnel who run for office.
c2196315.porQueImporta: Today they move to the reserve.

s8580579.titulo: Requires Congress's approval for binding Supreme Court precedents
s8580579.oQueMuda: The Supreme Court's binding precedents would be reviewed by Congress.
s8580579.porQueImporta: It would shift the balance between the branches.

s8582557.titulo: Requires Congress's approval to recognize Indigenous lands
s8582557.oQueMuda: Recognition of Indigenous lands would have to be approved by Congress.
s8582557.porQueImporta: Today recognition is done by the executive branch.

s8582970.titulo: Makes child sexual abuse a crime without bail or time limit
s8582970.oQueMuda: Child sexual abuse crimes would allow no bail and could be punished at any time.
s8582970.quemAfeta: Victims and those accused of these crimes.
s8582970.porQueImporta: Today these crimes expire after a certain period.

s8583613.titulo: Requires Congress's approval to recognize Indigenous lands
s8583613.oQueMuda: Recognition of Indigenous lands would depend on approval by Congress.
s8583613.porQueImporta: Today recognition is done by the executive branch.

c553109.titulo: Requires a degree to work as a journalist
c553109.oQueMuda: Again requires a university degree to work as a journalist.
c553109.porQueImporta: The Supreme Court struck down this requirement in 2009.

c1724712.titulo: Compensates owners of land declared Indigenous
c1724712.oQueMuda: Owners holding titles to areas declared Indigenous from 2013 onward could be compensated.

c2288318.titulo: Allows dual citizenship without losing Brazilian nationality
c2288318.oQueMuda: Brazilians would not lose their nationality when acquiring another, unless they ask to.
c2288318.porQueImporta: It protects the citizenship of those who naturalize in another country.

c621519.titulo: Gives permanent status to public workers hired without an exam
c621519.oQueMuda: People working for federal, state and city governments would be made permanent civil servants.
c621519.quemAfeta: Temporary and outsourced public sector workers.
c621519.porQueImporta: It goes against the public exam rule.

c2224532.titulo: Allows judges to swap posts between different courts
c2224532.oQueMuda: Judges could request a transfer or swap posts with colleagues in other courts of the same branch: state, federal or labor courts.
c2224532.porQueImporta: It makes it easier for judges to move to another city or state.

s8488781.titulo: Raises science investment to 2.5% of GDP
s8488781.oQueMuda: Investment in science, technology and innovation would gradually rise to at least 2.5% of GDP.
s8488781.porQueImporta: Brazil invests much less than that today.

c407657.titulo: Creates a fund to revitalize the São Francisco River
c407657.oQueMuda: Creates a fund to restore the environment and develop the São Francisco River basin.
c407657.quemAfeta: Residents of the São Francisco basin.
c407657.porQueImporta: It guarantees steady funding for the river.

c483817.titulo: Makes the Cerrado and the Caatinga national heritage
c483817.oQueMuda: These two biomes would be added to the national heritage areas.
c483817.quemAfeta: Residents and producers in the Cerrado and the Caatinga.
c483817.porQueImporta: It strengthens environmental protection of these biomes.

s8569449.oQueMuda: The federal government would top up the Municipal Participation Fund to keep the same share of GDP as in 2022.
s8569449.porQueImporta: It prevents a drop in transfers to cities.

c398998.titulo: Ends the 'constitutional fifth' in the courts
c398998.oQueMuda: Courts would no longer reserve seats for lawyers and prosecutors.
c398998.porQueImporta: It changes who reaches the courts.

s7720809.titulo: Guarantees a full public health team for pregnant women
s7720809.oQueMuda: The public health system (SUS) would have to provide a pediatrician, gynecologist, obstetrician, nurses and psychologist during prenatal care, birth and postpartum.

c2092664.titulo: Reserves 10% of individual amendments for public safety
c2092664.oQueMuda: 10% of legislators' individual budget amendments would go to public safety.
c2092664.porQueImporta: It guarantees public safety funding in the budget.

s8560990.titulo: Creates 15-year terms for Supreme Court justices
s8560990.oQueMuda: Supreme Court justices would serve 15-year terms with a minimum age of 50, with changes to how higher courts are chosen.
s8560990.quemAfeta: Justices of the Supreme Court and higher courts.
s8560990.porQueImporta: Today the post is held for life until age 75.

s8242831.titulo: Allows public and private companies to collect and process plasma
s8242831.oQueMuda: It allows public and private entities to collect, process and sell human plasma to make medicines, preferably for the public health system (SUS).
s8242831.quemAfeta: Blood donors, patients and Hemobrás (the state blood products company).
s8242831.porQueImporta: Today the Constitution bans the sale of blood and blood products.

s8442337.oQueMuda: Sets institutional rules for the prosecutors who work with the Courts of Accounts.
s8442337.quemAfeta: Audit prosecutors and Courts of Accounts.
s8442337.porQueImporta: It strengthens those who oversee the use of public money.

c406708.titulo: Sets aside budget money for affordable housing
c406708.oQueMuda: Federal, state and city governments would have to allocate fixed funds to social housing funds.
c406708.quemAfeta: Families without adequate housing and governments.
c406708.porQueImporta: It guarantees permanent funding for affordable housing.

s8513795.titulo: Tax reform abolishing the ICMS and Cide
s8513795.oQueMuda: Abolishes taxes such as the ICMS and Cide and creates new state tax rules.
s8513795.porQueImporta: It would change the structure of consumption taxes.

s8549385.titulo: Extends the right to life to the unborn
s8549385.oQueMuda: The right to life would protect the embryo from conception.
s8549385.porQueImporta: It could affect the cases in which abortion is currently allowed by law.

s8545103.titulo: Bans charging union fees to non-members
s8545103.oQueMuda: Unions could only charge non-members with their prior individual consent.
s8545103.porQueImporta: It responds to a Supreme Court ruling that allowed charging a support fee.

s7391043.titulo: Lets former workers of Amapá, Roraima and Rondônia join the federal payroll
s7391043.oQueMuda: Unifies criteria for transferring civil servants of the former territories and these states to the federal government.
s7391043.quemAfeta: Current and former civil servants of these states.
s7391043.porQueImporta: The federal government would take over paying this group's salaries and pensions.

s8539271.titulo: Requires Supreme Court justices to face a new hearing every 8 years
s8539271.oQueMuda: The Senate would hold a public hearing of Supreme Court justices every eight years.
s8539271.quemAfeta: Supreme Court justices and the Senate.
s8539271.porQueImporta: It increases the Senate's control over the Supreme Court.

s8538765.titulo: Temporarily raises transfers to the FPM
s8538765.oQueMuda: Raises for a period the share of income tax and IPI that goes to the Municipal Participation Fund.

s8540424.titulo: Bars judges from cases handled by relatives' law firms
s8540424.oQueMuda: Judges could not rule on cases with lawyers who are their spouses or close relatives.
s8540424.porQueImporta: It aims to avoid conflicts of interest.

s7723044.titulo: Guarantees cities the ICMS and IPVA that states fail to pass on
s7723044.oQueMuda: The federal government would withhold state funds and pay cities directly the share of ICMS and IPVA not passed on.

s8326366.titulo: Guarantees free public transit on election day
s8326366.oQueMuda: Buses, boats and intercity transport would be free on voting days.
s8326366.porQueImporta: It makes it easier to get to the polls.

c2223558.titulo: Exempts Brazilian-made musical instruments from taxes
c2223558.oQueMuda: Musical instruments made in Brazil would be tax-free.

c2225811.oQueMuda: Creates a new case in which Brazilians who naturalize through marriage keep their nationality.

s8520995.titulo: Changes how Congress's internal rules are amended
s8520995.oQueMuda: Sets how bills changing the internal rules of the Chamber and Senate are voted on.
s8520995.porQueImporta: It affects the rules for how the legislature works.

c1555497.titulo: Guarantees internet access and privacy of digital communications
c1555497.oQueMuda: Internet access and the secrecy of digital messages would be fundamental guarantees.
c1555497.porQueImporta: It strengthens privacy and digital inclusion.

s8513844.titulo: Guarantees free transit for low-income people with disabilities
s8513844.oQueMuda: Low-income people with disabilities would ride urban public transit for free.
s8513844.quemAfeta: People with disabilities and city governments.
s8513844.porQueImporta: It makes it easier to get to work, health care and school.

s8513893.titulo: Requires a verifiable printed ballot in elections
s8513893.oQueMuda: Voting machines would have to print a ballot the voter can check, kept for audits.
s8513893.porQueImporta: It would change the electronic voting system.

s8386303.titulo: Adds military court judges to the CNJ
s8386303.oQueMuda: Military court judges would get a seat on the National Council of Justice.
s8386303.quemAfeta: The military courts and the CNJ.
s8386303.porQueImporta: It changes the makeup of the body that oversees the judiciary.

c1738814.oQueMuda: Guarantees extra operating time for lottery outlet permits.
c1738814.porQueImporta: It avoids an immediate new tender for lottery outlets.

s8488965.titulo: Changes the process for provisional measures
s8488965.oQueMuda: Changes deadlines, agenda locking and reissuing of provisional measures (executive decrees).
s8488965.porQueImporta: It changes the government's power to create rules with immediate effect.

s8489404.titulo: Makes the Caatinga, Cerrado and Pampa national heritage
s8489404.oQueMuda: These three biomes would be added to the national heritage areas.
s8489404.quemAfeta: Residents and producers in these biomes.
s8489404.porQueImporta: It strengthens environmental protection in these regions.

c2118343.titulo: Limits civil servants' vacation to 30 days
c2118343.oQueMuda: All public employees would have 30 days of vacation a year, with one-third extra pay.
c2118343.quemAfeta: Civil servants, including judges and prosecutors.
c2118343.porQueImporta: Some careers have 60 days of vacation today.

c139244.titulo: Direct election of state attorneys general
c139244.oQueMuda: The heads of state prosecutors' offices would be elected by prosecutors themselves.
c139244.porQueImporta: Today the governor chooses from a list of three.

c2152285.titulo: Creates a democracy fund financed by politicians' salaries
c2152285.oQueMuda: Politicians and appointees would pay a contribution on their salaries to a fund financing democracy.
c2152285.quemAfeta: Elected politicians and holders of appointed posts.
c2152285.porQueImporta: It would create a new source to finance politics.

s8472168.titulo: Protects mental integrity and requires algorithm transparency
s8472168.oQueMuda: Adds protection of the mind against new technologies and algorithm transparency to fundamental rights.
s8472168.porQueImporta: It anticipates rules for neurotechnology and artificial intelligence.

c1050543.titulo: Allows seizing assets from crime or corruption
c1050543.oQueMuda: Prosecutors and government attorneys could ask courts to seize assets from crime, misconduct or illicit enrichment.
c1050543.quemAfeta: People with assets of illicit origin.
c1050543.porQueImporta: It makes it easier to recover diverted assets.

c427297.titulo: Guarantees night-shift pay to police and firefighters
c427297.oQueMuda: Military police, firefighters and other security agents would be entitled to night-shift pay.
c427297.porQueImporta: It would raise the pay of those who work at night.

c1278930.titulo: Sets working hours for military police and firefighters
c1278930.oQueMuda: Defines daily and weekly working hours for military police and firefighters.
c1278930.porQueImporta: Today the Constitution sets no working-hour limit for them.

c2092228.titulo: Places notary offices among the functions essential to justice
c2092228.oQueMuda: Notaries and registrars would get their own section in the Constitution.

s5073365.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for the area.

s7975882.titulo: Extends book tax exemption to digital formats
s7975882.oQueMuda: Books, newspapers and magazines, including digital ones, would be free from all taxes.
s7975882.porQueImporta: It could prevent book price increases.

s7986137.titulo: Makes internet access a social right
s7986137.oQueMuda: The state would have a duty to guarantee internet access to everyone living in the country.
s7986137.porQueImporta: It requires the government to expand connectivity.

s7987247.titulo: Repeals the spending cap and creates spending targets
s7987247.oQueMuda: Repeals the spending cap amendment and sets spending targets in the multi-year plan, with extra spending in 2021 and 2022.
s7987247.quemAfeta: The federal government and social program recipients.
s7987247.porQueImporta: It changes the main spending control rule of the time.
s7987247.apelido: End of the Spending Cap PEC

s8448291.titulo: Creates an income-based contribution to repay student loans
s8448291.oQueMuda: Allows a tax so former students repay their loans according to future income.
s8448291.quemAfeta: Students who use loans such as Fies.
s8448291.porQueImporta: It would change how student loans are repaid.

c323818.titulo: Splits oil and mining royalties by population and HDI
c323818.oQueMuda: Money from oil, gas and mining would be divided among states and cities by population, area and Human Development Index.
c323818.quemAfeta: States and cities, producers or not.
c323818.porQueImporta: It would change who receives royalties.

c1049154.titulo: Makes access to energy a social right
c1049154.oQueMuda: Access to electricity would be listed among social rights.
c1049154.quemAfeta: People without power and low-income consumers.
c1049154.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to supply energy.

c1230264.titulo: Increases the share of income tax and IPI sent to cities
c1230264.oQueMuda: Raises the percentage of these taxes going to the Municipal Participation Fund.

c2075915.titulo: Makes internet access a fundamental right
c2075915.oQueMuda: Universal internet access would be a fundamental guarantee for everyone.
c2075915.porQueImporta: It requires the government to expand connectivity.

c2088568.titulo: Adds support for women victims of violence to social assistance
c2088568.oQueMuda: Social assistance would aim to support women who are victims of violence.
c2088568.porQueImporta: It strengthens the support network for these women.

c2198865.titulo: Updates the wording to 'person with a disability'
c2198865.oQueMuda: The Constitution would use the phrase 'person with a disability' throughout.
c2198865.porQueImporta: It aligns the language with the international convention.

s7834640.titulo: Restricts appeals to the Supreme Court in criminal cases
s7834640.oQueMuda: Extraordinary appeals to the Supreme Court would no longer be allowed in criminal matters.
s7834640.quemAfeta: Criminal defendants and the Supreme Court.
s7834640.porQueImporta: It would speed up the end of criminal cases.

s7933328.oQueMuda: The government would have to encourage payments to those who preserve nature and create jobs in environmental activities.
s7933328.porQueImporta: It creates incentives to protect the environment.

s7959745.titulo: Requires a list of three to choose the Prosecutor General
s7959745.oQueMuda: The President would choose the Prosecutor General from a list drawn up by federal prosecutors.

s8323670.titulo: Gives the Supreme Court jurisdiction over crimes against democracy
s8323670.oQueMuda: Crimes against the democratic rule of law would be tried directly by the Supreme Court.
s8323670.quemAfeta: People accused of these crimes and the Supreme Court.
s8323670.porQueImporta: It changes the court responsible for these cases.

s7899802.titulo: Creates a fund to fight child poverty
s7899802.oQueMuda: Creates a fund with child poverty reduction targets and rewards for governments that make progress.
s7899802.porQueImporta: It sets targets and resources to reduce poverty.

s7901820.titulo: Creates guarantee funds for small businesses
s7901820.oQueMuda: Creates funds to guarantee loans to micro, small and medium-sized businesses in the regions.
s7901820.porQueImporta: It makes credit easier to get.

s7905790.titulo: Exempts donations to NGOs and research institutes from tax
s7905790.oQueMuda: Donations and bequests to nonprofit organizations would not pay the inheritance and gift tax (ITCMD).

s7916284.titulo: Postponed the 2020 municipal elections because of the pandemic
s7916284.oQueMuda: Allowed the Superior Electoral Court to postpone the 2020 elections and set terms to unify elections from 2026.
s7916284.porQueImporta: It dealt with holding elections during the pandemic.

s7917387.titulo: Unifies elections by extending municipal terms
s7917387.oQueMuda: Mayors and council members elected in 2016 would serve 6-year terms to coincide with other elections.
s7917387.porQueImporta: It would change the election calendar.

s7917934.titulo: Counts pandemic work time double for retirement
s7917934.oQueMuda: Public health and security workers who fought COVID-19 would have that time counted double for retirement.
s7917934.porQueImporta: It would bring these workers' retirements forward.

c104989.titulo: Lets seconded civil servants transfer permanently
c104989.oQueMuda: Civil servants on loan to another body could choose to stay where they work.
c104989.quemAfeta: Civil servants on loan to other bodies.
c104989.porQueImporta: It changes civil servants' placement without a new exam.

s8077867.titulo: Extends pension debt installment plans to 240 months
s8077867.oQueMuda: Governments could pay debts to their employees' pension systems in up to 240 installments during the pandemic.
s8077867.quemAfeta: States, cities and their civil servants.
s8077867.porQueImporta: It eased public finances during the crisis.

s8078289.titulo: Bans tax increases during the pandemic
s8078289.oQueMuda: Governments could not create or raise taxes during the emergency, except to fight it.
s8078289.porQueImporta: It aimed to avoid a heavier tax burden during the crisis.

s8097900.titulo: Extends pension debt installment plans until 2021
s8097900.oQueMuda: Extends installment plans for governments' pension debts to 240 months and allows debt forgiveness.
s8097900.quemAfeta: States, cities and their civil servants.

s8099954.titulo: Creates quotas for Black candidates and by gender in the legislature
s8099954.oQueMuda: Sets minimum shares of candidates of each gender and of Black people, and reserves campaign funds and TV time for them.
s8099954.quemAfeta: Parties, women candidates and Black candidates.
s8099954.porQueImporta: It aims to increase diversity in legislatures.

s8113511.titulo: Creates the Opportunities Amendment with a minimum income
s8113511.oQueMuda: Guarantees a minimum income and reserves budget money to expand early education and other opportunities.
s8113511.porQueImporta: It would give constitutional backing to income and education policies.

s8138727.titulo: Sends the top three candidates to the runoff
s8138727.oQueMuda: If no one wins a majority in the first round, the three top candidates would compete in the second.
s8138727.quemAfeta: Voters and candidates for president, governor and mayor.
s8138727.porQueImporta: Today only the top two go to the runoff.

s8154053.titulo: Changes the ICMS on fuel, gas and electricity
s8154053.oQueMuda: Changes how the ICMS is charged on petroleum products, cooking gas and electricity.
s8154053.porQueImporta: It could change the price of these products.

s8154081.titulo: Bans using the science fund to pay debt
s8154081.oQueMuda: Money from the National Science and Technology Development Fund could not be used to pay down the public debt.

s8158286.titulo: Creates a national career for public health system doctors
s8158286.oQueMuda: Creates a national career for doctors in the public health system (SUS), with set requirements and pay.
s8158286.quemAfeta: Doctors and patients of the SUS.
s8158286.porQueImporta: It aims to bring doctors to regions that lack them.

s8163561.titulo: Creates Auxílio Brasil and transparency rules for amendments
s8163561.oQueMuda: Replaces Bolsa Família with Auxílio Brasil and requires transparency in carrying out legislators' amendments.
s8163561.porQueImporta: It dealt with the main cash transfer program of the time.

s8166899.titulo: Makes basic income a social right
s8166899.oQueMuda: Guarantees income to vulnerable families and creates fiscal exceptions to pay for the benefit.
s8166899.porQueImporta: It would give constitutional backing to cash transfer programs.

s8167542.titulo: Sends part of legislators' amendments to fighting poverty
s8167542.oQueMuda: Part of individual budget amendments would have to go to anti-poverty actions.
s8167542.porQueImporta: It guarantees funding for this area in the budget.

s7752094.titulo: Applies the salary cap to organizations receiving public money
s7752094.oQueMuda: Nonprofits funded with public resources, such as the 'S System' training bodies, would have to respect the salary cap.
s7752094.quemAfeta: Directors and staff of these organizations.
s7752094.porQueImporta: It limits salaries paid with indirect public money.

s8436103.titulo: Expands the Federal Public Defender's budget
s8436103.oQueMuda: The Federal Public Defender's Office would get yearly increases in its spending limit for 10 years.
s8436103.quemAfeta: People who rely on public defenders, and the defenders.
s8436103.porQueImporta: It would let the office reach more cities.

s8436730.oQueMuda: Medicines for human use would be tax-free.

s8437557.titulo: Adds a Federal District appeals judge to the CNJ
s8437557.oQueMuda: The National Council of Justice would gain an appeals judge from the Federal District Court of Justice.
s8437557.quemAfeta: The Federal District courts and the CNJ.
s8437557.porQueImporta: It changes the makeup of the body that oversees the judiciary.

c2084043.titulo: Makes spending on agricultural research mandatory
c2084043.oQueMuda: The government would have to carry out budget funds for scientific research in agriculture and livestock.

s8305239.titulo: Gives special retirement to municipal guards
s8305239.oQueMuda: Municipal guards would be entitled to special retirement.
s8305239.porQueImporta: It would let them retire earlier.

s8306962.titulo: Raises the March FPM transfer by 1%
s8306962.oQueMuda: The federal government would hand an extra 1% of its revenue to the Municipal Participation Fund every March.

s8319791.oQueMuda: Creates a basic income benefit with defined funding sources.
s8319791.porQueImporta: It would give constitutional backing to cash transfer programs.

s8320782.titulo: Bans selling state-owned companies between election and inauguration
s8320782.oQueMuda: Governments could not sell public assets or control of state companies during the transition period.
s8320782.porQueImporta: It prevents long-term decisions by those leaving office.

s8329085.titulo: Bans political statements by Supreme Court justices
s8329085.oQueMuda: Justices of the Supreme Court and higher courts could not make political statements, or they would commit an impeachable offense.
s8329085.porQueImporta: It aims to strengthen judicial impartiality.

s8331055.titulo: Creates an integrity system and anti-corruption courts
s8331055.oQueMuda: Establishes an integrity system in the judiciary and specialized courts for crimes against public administration.
s8331055.quemAfeta: Courts and defendants in corruption cases.
s8331055.porQueImporta: It aims to speed up corruption cases.

s8332695.titulo: Gives Congress the say on suspending legislators' social media
s8332695.oQueMuda: Only the Chamber and the Senate could suspend or remove their members' online profiles and channels.
s8332695.porQueImporta: It responds to court rulings that blocked legislators' profiles.

s8291388.oQueMuda: The federal government would have to create an ombudsman to receive complaints and fight violence against women.
s8291388.porQueImporta: It creates a federal reporting channel.

s8293254.titulo: Creates binding precedents for the Superior Court of Justice
s8293254.oQueMuda: The Superior Court of Justice could issue precedents all judges would have to follow.
s8293254.quemAfeta: Judges, lawyers and parties to cases.
s8293254.porQueImporta: It could reduce conflicting rulings and appeals.

c2351680.oQueMuda: Sets criteria and bans for sentence pardons granted by the President.
c2351680.porQueImporta: It reduces the President's power to pardon.

s7741352.titulo: Raises the share of income tax and IPI sent to states to 26%
s7741352.oQueMuda: The share of income tax and IPI for the State Participation Fund would rise by 4.5 points.
s7741352.quemAfeta: State governments and the federal government.

s8402530.titulo: Adds the Federal Waterway Police to public safety
s8402530.oQueMuda: The Federal Waterway Police would become part of the public safety system.
s8402530.quemAfeta: Residents of river regions and the Federal Police.

s8406896.titulo: Guarantees protection for security and health workers
s8406896.oQueMuda: Protecting these workers would be a fundamental right.
s8406896.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty to protect them.

s8407865.titulo: Restricts appointments to state company boards
s8407865.oQueMuda: Bans appointing people with conflicts of interest to boards and management of state-owned companies.
s8407865.porQueImporta: It aims to prevent political use of these companies.

c2231670.titulo: Creates committees to reduce health lawsuits
c2231670.oQueMuda: States would have multi-agency committees to resolve health requests without going to court.
c2231670.quemAfeta: Patients, the public health system (SUS) and the judiciary.
c2231670.porQueImporta: It aims to give faster answers to treatment requests.

s8220747.titulo: Lets all judges vote to elect court leadership
s8220747.oQueMuda: Court leadership (except the internal affairs office) would be elected by all tenured first- and second-instance judges in the region, by secret ballot, for 2-year terms.
s8220747.porQueImporta: It changes who chooses court leadership, today elected only by appellate judges.

s8221418.titulo: Allows converting hazardous work time to regular time for retirement
s8221418.oQueMuda: Social security contributors who worked in hazardous activities could convert that time into regular time.
s8221418.porQueImporta: It could bring retirements forward, which the 2019 reform had banned.

s8222502.titulo: Reserves women-only lists for court seats
s8222502.oQueMuda: One in every two nomination lists for the 'constitutional fifth' seats would be made up only of women.
s8222502.quemAfeta: Women lawyers, prosecutors and the courts.
s8222502.porQueImporta: It aims to increase women's presence on the courts.

s8230006.oQueMuda: Donations of goods and services for humanitarian aid would be tax-free.

s8394951.titulo: Alternates where provisional measures start between Chamber and Senate
s8394951.oQueMuda: Provisional measures would start alternately in the Chamber and the Senate, and joint committees would be abolished.
s8394951.porQueImporta: It changes how provisional measures are reviewed.

c2132847.titulo: Sends work-related social security cases to the Labor Courts
c2132847.oQueMuda: Cases about work-related social security benefits, such as accidents, would go to the Labor Courts.
c2132847.quemAfeta: Injured workers and the national social security institute (INSS).
c2132847.porQueImporta: It changes which court hears these cases.

s7760703.titulo: Bans pardons for heinous and corruption crimes
s7760703.oQueMuda: The President could not pardon sentences for heinous crimes, money laundering and crimes against public administration.
s7760703.porQueImporta: It reduces the President's power to pardon.

s8373076.titulo: Strengthens protection of final court rulings
s8373076.oQueMuda: Reaffirms that final rulings cannot be undone, including by changes in Supreme Court interpretation.
s8373076.quemAfeta: Taxpayers and parties to closed cases.
s8373076.porQueImporta: It responds to a Supreme Court ruling on reviewing tax cases.

c2222337.titulo: Shares pre-salt auction revenue with states and cities
c2222337.oQueMuda: The federal government would share with states and cities revenue from the pre-salt oil rights auction.
c2222337.quemAfeta: States, cities and the federal government.

c2351620.titulo: Requires Congress's approval for loans to other countries
c2351620.oQueMuda: Federal public banks could only lend to foreign countries with Congress's authorization.
c2351620.quemAfeta: The BNDES and other public banks.
c2351620.porQueImporta: It expands control over these loans.

s1400311.titulo: Sets deadlines to appoint officials approved by the Senate
s1400311.oQueMuda: Creates deadlines to choose and appoint officials such as agency directors, with an impeachable offense if missed.
s1400311.porQueImporta: It keeps posts from staying vacant for long.

s1401169.titulo: Requires a complementary law for concession rules
s1401169.oQueMuda: Public service concessions and permits would be regulated by a complementary law.
s1401169.quemAfeta: Concession holders and public service users.
s1401169.porQueImporta: It makes changing concession rules harder.

s3037753.titulo: Changes how the Cide fuel tax is shared with states and cities
s3037753.oQueMuda: Redistributes the revenue from the Cide fuel tax differently among states and cities.
s3037753.porQueImporta: It affects money used for transport and roads.

s7411048.titulo: Makes it easier to arrest and prosecute legislators
s7411048.oQueMuda: Allows arresting legislators after a second-instance conviction and ends Congress's power to block arrests and cases.
s7411048.porQueImporta: It reduces protections legislators have today.

s1401465.oQueMuda: Changes the system of government to parliamentarism, with a prime minister.
s1401465.porQueImporta: It would change the country's system of government.

s1401414.titulo: Changes how attorneys general are chosen
s1401414.oQueMuda: The Prosecutor General could also come from state prosecutors' offices, and attorneys general would have to step down before seeking reappointment.
s1401414.porQueImporta: It changes who leads the prosecution service.

s7914500.titulo: Creates a fixed term and list of three for the Federal Police chief
s7914500.oQueMuda: The Federal Police director would be chosen from a list of three, with a three-year term and Senate approval.
s7914500.quemAfeta: The Federal Police and the Presidency.
s7914500.porQueImporta: It gives the Federal Police more independence.

s7989488.titulo: Requires officeholders to step down to seek reelection
s7989488.oQueMuda: The President, governors and mayors seeking reelection would have to take leave six months before.
s7989488.quemAfeta: Heads of the executive and voters.
s7989488.porQueImporta: It aims to prevent using the government apparatus in campaigns.

c2325720.titulo: Halves city governments' social security contributions
c2325720.oQueMuda: Cities would pay half the contribution rate on their payroll.
c2325720.porQueImporta: It eases cities and reduces social security revenue.

c501028.titulo: Allows using court-ordered government debts to buy a home
c501028.oQueMuda: Credits from court-ordered government debts (precatórios) could be used to buy a home.
c501028.porQueImporta: It would give immediate use to debts governments are slow to pay.

s1401223.titulo: Guarantees women seats on Congress's governing boards and committees
s1401223.oQueMuda: The makeup of governing boards and committees would have to be proportional to the number of each gender.
s1401223.porQueImporta: It aims to increase women's presence in Congress's leadership.

s8392917.titulo: Changes where the President's bills start
s8392917.oQueMuda: Bills from the President and the courts could start in the Senate, not only in the Chamber.
s8392917.porQueImporta: It shifts the balance between the Chamber and the Senate.

s8133142.titulo: Requires free, science-based public health care
s8133142.oQueMuda: Public health actions and services would have to be free and based on scientific evidence.
s8133142.quemAfeta: Patients of the public health system (SUS).

s8171441.titulo: Sets rules for adding new treatments to the public health system
s8171441.oQueMuda: Creates criteria for adding new medicines and procedures to the SUS, with mandatory prior review.
s8171441.porQueImporta: It affects which treatments reach the public system.

s1394077.titulo: Reserves legislative seats for people with disabilities
s1394077.oQueMuda: Seats in the Chamber, state assemblies and city councils would be reserved for people with disabilities for four legislatures.
s1394077.porQueImporta: It aims to increase this group's representation.

s1394130.titulo: Creates the Racial Equality Promotion Fund
s1394130.oQueMuda: Creates a fund for policies including Black Brazilians in housing, education and job training.
s1394130.porQueImporta: It would guarantee steady funding for these policies.

s1394231.titulo: Gives priority to bills on the same subject as provisional measures
s1394231.oQueMuda: Bills on the same topic as a provisional measure would be reviewed alongside it, with priority for the oldest.
s1394231.porQueImporta: It gives more weight to legislators' proposals than the executive's.

s1394282.titulo: Creates national rules for public service exams
s1394282.oQueMuda: Exams would have to offer all open positions, and exams just for a waiting list or new exams with approved candidates still waiting would be banned.
s1394282.porQueImporta: It gives more security to those who pass.

s1394688.titulo: Extends special retirement rules for teachers in the transition
s1394688.oQueMuda: Basic education teachers would get five years off the requirements under the 2005 transition rule too.
s1394688.porQueImporta: It would let them retire earlier.

s1394843.titulo: Adjusts pensions by the most favorable inflation index
s1394843.oQueMuda: Social security benefits would be adjusted by the inflation index most favorable to retirees.
s1394843.quemAfeta: Retirees and pensioners of the national social security system.
s1394843.porQueImporta: It would raise benefits and social security spending.

s1394997.titulo: Calls an assembly to carry out political reform
s1394997.oQueMuda: Voters would elect representatives to a review assembly devoted only to political and electoral reform.
s1394997.porQueImporta: It would change political rules outside Congress.

s1402212.oQueMuda: People not affiliated with parties could run in elections.
s1402212.porQueImporta: Today you can only run through a party.

s7242157.titulo: Automatically removes legislators convicted under the Clean Record Law
s7242157.oQueMuda: Deputies and senators convicted of crimes that cause ineligibility would lose their seats automatically.
s7242157.porQueImporta: Today removal depends on a vote in the chamber.

s7399577.titulo: Reserves 2% of legislators' amendments for sports
s7399577.oQueMuda: At least 2% of individual budget amendments would go to sports.
s7399577.porQueImporta: It guarantees sports funding in the budget.

c1280152.titulo: Charges ICMS on interstate electricity sales
c1280152.oQueMuda: The ICMS would apply to electricity transactions between states.
c1280152.porQueImporta: It would change states' revenue from energy.

c1594140.titulo: Allows reducing states' delegations in the Chamber
c1594140.oQueMuda: Ends the rule that prevents reducing the number of deputies from each state.
c1594140.porQueImporta: It would allow redistributing seats by population.

c609753.titulo: Federal aid to pay the nursing salary floor
c609753.oQueMuda: The federal government would give financial support to states, municipalities, charities and private providers serving at least 60% public health system (SUS) patients so they can pay the nursing salary floor.
c609753.quemAfeta: Nursing professionals, city governments, charity hospitals and hospitals serving SUS.
c609753.porQueImporta: It made it possible to pay the profession's minimum salary.

c1701050.titulo: Bans creating costs for governments without naming a funding source
c1701050.oQueMuda: Laws could not impose costs on federal, state and city governments without provision in the budget.
c1701050.porQueImporta: It prevents laws that create spending with no money to pay for it.

c43596.titulo: Guarantees yearly funding for the Amazon and Northeast funds
c43596.oQueMuda: A law would set mandatory yearly amounts for these regions' development funds.
c43596.quemAfeta: Companies and governments in the Amazon and Northeast.
c43596.porQueImporta: It guarantees money for regional development.

c2194899.titulo: Takes federal university spending out of the cap (text of the Transition PEC)
c2194899.oQueMuda: Excludes federal education institutions' spending from the spending cap; in 2022 it was the text used to vote on the Transition PEC.
c2194899.porQueImporta: It freed spending outside the fiscal limit.

c620527.oQueMuda: Federal and state governments would have to spend a minimum percentage on cultural heritage and cultural production.

c2095531.oQueMuda: Brazil would treat other countries the way they treat it.

c2194813.oQueMuda: Cooking gas for household use would be tax-free.
c2194813.porQueImporta: It could make gas cylinders cheaper.

c2230007.titulo: Guarantees income for families in poverty
c2230007.oQueMuda: Social assistance would have to guarantee cash transfers to poor and extremely poor families.
c2230007.porQueImporta: It would make a cash transfer program permanent.

c2285501.titulo: Let cities pay pension debts in 240 installments
c2285501.oQueMuda: In 2021, cities could pay their social security debts in up to 240 monthly installments.

c2304959.titulo: Makes a stable climate a fundamental right
c2304959.oQueMuda: Adds the climate issue to fundamental rights, the economy and environmental protection.
c2304959.porQueImporta: It strengthens the state's duty in the face of climate change.

c2336964.titulo: Federal aid to pay the nursing minimum wage
c2336964.oQueMuda: The federal government would give financial support to states, cities and charities to meet the nursing minimum salary.
c2336964.porQueImporta: It makes paying the profession's minimum salary possible.

s7728717.titulo: Adds the National Force to the public safety bodies
s7728717.oQueMuda: The National Public Safety Force would be a permanent body for cooperation among governments.
s7728717.quemAfeta: The National Force and the states.
s7728717.porQueImporta: It gives the National Force a constitutional basis.

s7732135.titulo: Separates electoral crimes from ordinary crimes in court cases
s7732135.oQueMuda: Ordinary crimes linked to electoral crimes would be tried by the regular courts.
s7732135.quemAfeta: Defendants in corruption and slush-fund cases.
s7732135.porQueImporta: It responds to a Supreme Court ruling that sent these cases to the electoral courts.
